items.title: VW y sindicato discutirán la próxima semana las preocupaciones sobre la reestructuración: fuente
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Volkswagen y los representantes sindicales se reunirán la próxima semana para debatir la reestructuración radical del fabricante de automóviles alemán, según informó el miércoles una fuente a Reuters, después de que el sindicato IG Metall convocara a la dirección ante la preocupación por los recortes.
items.body:
Volkswagen y los representantes sindicales se reunirán la próxima semana para debatir la reestructuración radical del fabricante de automóviles alemán, según informó el miércoles una fuente a Reuters, después de que el sindicato IG Metall convocara a la dirección ante la preocupación por los recortes.
Los representantes de la empresa, de IG Metall y del comité de empresa se reunirán en Hannover el 30 de septiembre, según indicó la fuente involucrada en las negociaciones.
El periódico financiero Handelsblatt fue el primero en dar a conocer la fecha.
Más temprano en el mes, IG Metall anunció que invocaría una cláusula especial de su histórico convenio colectivo de 2024 con Volkswagen , exigiendo que la empresa cumpliera los compromisos en materia de empleo e inversión adquiridos en dicho acuerdo.
Esta medida supuso una escalada en la lucha por el futuro de Volkswagen. El conflictivo consejo de supervisión del grupo aprobó este mes un plan para duplicar los despidos hasta alcanzar unas 100.000 personas, pero aún quedan muchos detalles por acordar.
Las plantas de producción alemanas se encuentran bajo una presión especial, ya que cuatro de ellas se enfrentan a un posible cierre a partir de principios de la próxima década.

items.title: Bulgaria lifts fuel export ban to ease Lukoil's refinery operations
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bulgaria on Wednesday approved lifting a ban on fuel exports to other EU countries that has been in place since last year to protect domestic supplies after US sanctions targeted Russia's Lukoil, operator of the country's biggest oil refinery.
items.body:
Bulgaria on Wednesday approved lifting a ban on fuel exports to other EU countries that [USN:L6N3WC0SZ TEXT:"has been in place"] since last year to protect domestic supplies after US sanctions targeted Russia's Lukoil, operator of the country's biggest oil refinery.
The measure was approved by parliament by 121 votes to 42, with 23 lawmakers abstaining.
The government has said the ban, mainly on diesel and aviation fuel, hit the activities of Lukoil's (LKOH.MM) refinery and posed significant administrative and organisational difficulties for fuel businesses, causing financial losses for some operators which failed to meet contractual obligations to international partners.
It also said the ban went against the free movement of goods principle of the EU single market.
Lukoil runs Bulgaria's 190,000-barrel-per-day Burgas oil refinery, operates more than 200 petrol stations and has a fuel transport and depot network.

items.title: Víctimas de presuntos abusos de sacerdote esloveno piden a papa León XIV acelerar juicio eclesiástico
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cinco víctimas de presuntos abusos por parte de un destacado sacerdote vinculado al Vaticano instaron el miércoles al papa León XIV a que presione para que concluya el juicio eclesiástico contra el clérigo, que ya dura casi un año, alegando que un proceso prolongado y secreto les está privando de justicia.
items.body:
Cinco víctimas de presuntos abusos por parte de un destacado sacerdote vinculado al Vaticano instaron el miércoles al papa León XIV a que presione para que concluya el juicio eclesiástico contra el clérigo, que ya dura casi un año, alegando que un proceso prolongado y secreto les está privando de justicia.
En una carta abierta previa a la visita de cuatro días de León XIV a Francia, donde el Santo Padre espera restaurar la reputación de la Iglesia tras los escándalos de abusos ocurridos allí, las víctimas del reverendo Marko Rupnik dijeron que el trato que han recibido pone en entredicho el compromiso de la Iglesia de ayudar a las víctimas.
"Este es el mensaje que se transmite… que es inútil denunciar los abusos a las autoridades eclesiásticas, porque de todos modos no pasa nada y nadie rendirá cuentas", se lee en la carta.
Las víctimas dijeron que no habían recibido ninguna información sobre el juicio eclesiástico y que no habían podido prestar testimonio.
Instaron al Sumo Pontífice a presionar para que se celebre un juicio justo "de modo que la sentencia y su resultado, sea cual sea, queden libres de toda sombra de duda".
La oficina de prensa del Vaticano no hizo comentarios de inmediato.
Rupnik, un sacerdote esloveno, es un artista religioso cuyos mosaicos adornan unas 200 iglesias y capillas de todo el mundo, incluida una basílica en Lourdes, Francia, que el Papa visitará el sábado.
El obispo de Lourdes ha ordenado que se cubran los mosaicos con motivo de la visita del Papa.
Más de 20 mujeres, en su mayoría antiguas monjas, han acusado a Rupnik de abusos sexuales y psicológicos.
El sacerdote fue expulsado de la orden de los jesuitas en 2023, tras considerarse que las acusaciones contra él eran "muy altamente" creíbles.
El responsable de la poderosa oficina doctrinal del Vaticano anunció por primera vez un juicio eclesiástico contra Rupnik en octubre de 2025. Estos juicios se celebran a puerta cerrada y desde entonces ha habido pocas novedades. En julio, el Vaticano desmintió las informaciones que apuntaban a que se hubiera tomado una decisión sobre el caso.

items.title: India's Ultraviolette taps Intel CEO as adviser, raises $85 million
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India's Ultraviolette brought on Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan as an adviser, the electric motorcycle manufacturer said on Wednesday, as it plans to expand internationally.
items.body:
India's Ultraviolette brought on Intel (INTC.O) CEO Lip-Bu Tan as an adviser, the electric motorcycle manufacturer said on Wednesday, as it plans to expand internationally.
Tan also participated in an $85 million funding round, along with deep-tech venture capital firms, with the Indian firm aiming to increase production and expand its product line.
Here are some more details:
TVS Motor-backed (TVSM.NS) Ultraviolette, which has a presence in Europe and India, is targeting a US entry in 2027, along with expansion across key markets in Latin America and Southeast Asia.
Yali Capital, where Tan serves as an adviser, and TDK Ventures participated in the funding round, along with other investors.
Ultraviolette will use the newly raised funds to scale production for its current products, launch upcoming models Tesseract and Shockwave, and develop its next generation of EV platforms.
Reuters [USN:L6N4500JH TEXT:"earlier reported"] that the EV startup is looking to invest 7.79 billion rupees ($81.37 million) in a new plant to expand its manufacturing capacity and support its entry into the mass-market segment.
Ultraviolette registrations have nearly tripled year-to-date compared to the previous year, according to data from the national vehicle registry, as Indians increasingly adopt electric vehicles due to their lower operating costs, fuel-price volatility and regulatory support.
($1 = 95.7400 Indian rupees)

items.title: エチオピア北部で戦闘再燃、反政府勢力が空港掌握
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２３日　ロイター］ - アフリカのエチオピア北部ティグレ州の指導部は２３日、連邦政府との新たな戦争に入ったと表明した。ティグレ州と隣接するアファール州、アムハラ州で戦闘が発生し、４年前に結ばれた和平合意は崩壊した。

アビー首相の顧問は、反政府勢力のティグレ人民解放戦線（ＴＰＬＦ）がティグレ州内で連邦政府の管理下にあった空港を掌握し、隣接するアファール州とアムハラ州の政府軍拠点に対して「全面攻勢」を開始したとＸに投稿。エチオピア航空はティグレ州向けの運航を停止した。

エチオピアでは、２０２０─２２年にＴＰＬＦと連邦政府軍の間で内戦が起き、数十万人が死亡した。２２年１１月にプレトリア合意が締結されたが、数カ月前から対立が強まり、ＴＰＬＦは２１日、アビー政権打倒を目指し、エチオピア各地の武装組織６団体と同盟を結成したと発表していた。

ＴＰＬＦ主導のティグレ州政府は声明で「アビー・アハメドの独裁的かつジェノサイド的な政権が、ティグレの人々に対してさまざまな手段による侵攻を激化させたことを受け、ティグレ州政府はティグレ軍に反撃を指示し、防衛戦争に入ったと発表した」と述べた。

items.title: Sindicato de supervisores de mina chilena Escondida dice buscará rechazar oferta de contrato; abrir vía a huelga
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El sindicato de supervisores de la mina chilena de cobre Escondida, controlada por BHP, buscará que sus socios rechacen una oferta presentada por la compañía, lo que allanaría el camino a una huelga en el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, informó el gremio.
items.body:
El sindicato de supervisores de la mina chilena de cobre Escondida, controlada por BHP, buscará que sus socios rechacen una oferta presentada por la compañía, lo que allanaría el camino a una huelga en el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, informó el gremio.
La empresa presentó al final de la jornada del martes la última propuesta del proceso formal de diálogo, que ahora será votada del 28 al 30 de septiembre por los integrantes del sindicato.
"Esta última oferta que entrega la empresa carece de los temas esenciales", dijo el presidente del gremio, Alexis Barrera, en un video enviado a los socios.
"Como directorio de forma unánime rechazamos esta última oferta y los llamamos a votar la huelga", agregó.
Sin embargo, de rechazarse la oferta las partes tendrán una mediación obligatoria gubernamental de cinco días -que puede ser extendida por otros cinco días de mutuo acuerdo-, antes de estar habilitados para iniciar una paralización legal.
Los trabajadores han rechazado algunos puntos planteados por la empresa como realizar labores de faenas y la posibilidad de habilitarse un turno de 14-14 días de trabajo/descanso en contingencias.
La compañía dijo tras entregar la oferta que la misma "contiene mejoras y nuevos beneficios sobre el actual contrato colectivo, el cual ya es un instrumento líder en la industria para el segmento de supervisores y staff, según distintos análisis comparativos con el mercado minero".
Escondida agregó que el nuevo contrato vendrá en un periodo "marcado por menores niveles de producción, presión sobre los costos y la ejecución de un plan de inversiones para mantener su capacidad productiva hacia el futuro".

items.title: Surging Pirates set sights on silencing Cardinals in rematch
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates were eliminated from playoff contention last week, but they appear determined to head into the offseason on a high note.
items.body:
The Pittsburgh Pirates were eliminated from playoff contention last week, but they appear determined to head into the offseason on a high note.
The Pirates (80-77) will seek their season-high sixth straight victory on Wednesday night when they continue a three-game series against the visiting St. Louis Cardinals (76-81).
Jared Jones and two relievers combined on a one-hitter in Pittsburgh's 2-0 win in the series opener on Tuesday. The Pirates broke a scoreless tie with two outs in the sixth inning on Ryan O'Hearn's RBI single.
St. Louis was stymied at the plate by Jones, who lowered his ERA to 1.08 in four September starts and allowed one hit with nine strikeouts and no walks over seven innings.
"(The Pirates) pitch really well," St. Louis manager Oliver Marmol said. "They have a lot of arms in the rotation and the bullpen. We ran into one today; Jones did a really nice job. Lot of swing and miss. We couldn't put a whole lot in play against him."
The Pirates have gone 15-6 in their last 21 games and are two wins away from finishing a season with a winning record for the first time since going 82-79 in 2018.
Catcher Rafael Flores Jr. has reached base safely in 15 consecutive games for the Pirates, who have set a single-season franchise record with 181 home runs.
While Pittsburgh will miss the playoffs for the 11th straight season, O'Hearn said the pieces are in place for a promising future.
"This definitely feels like a group to build off of," O'Hearn told the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette. "I'm not the GM; I don't make those decisions in the offseason, but it definitely feels like a group that's building together moving forward. Doesn't feel like the end. I've been on teams where it kind of felt like the end of an era type of thing, but this feels like a team that you want to build forward with."
The Pirates will use a bullpen game on Wednesday, with right-hander Lake Bachar (1-4, 3.56 ERA) getting the start.
Bachar pitched an inning as the opener on Sunday, allowing one run on three hits against the Kansas City Royals. He is 0-2 with a 2.92 ERA in 13 games since being acquired from the Miami Marlins on Aug. 3.
St. Louis will counter with left-hander Matthew Liberatore (5-14, 5.36 ERA), who pitched six innings of one-run ball in a no-decision against the San Francisco Giants last Wednesday. St. Louis lost 6-5 in 10 innings.
Liberatore, 26, has struggled to build on his success from last season, when he posted a 4.21 ERA over 151 2/3 innings.
"It's certainly not the season I wanted or the season anyone was expecting me to have," Liberatore said. "But I'm grateful for what I've gone through this year. I think it's really forced me to understand myself better and understand my identity and what I need to do to be successful at this level."
Oneil Cruz is 4-for-17 (.235) and Bryan Reynolds is 6-for-18 (.333) with a home run against Liberatore, who is 2-4 with a 5.60 ERA in 12 career games (eight starts) vs. Pittsburgh, including 0-1 with a 6.10 mark in two outings this season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: LA28 da a conocer los recorridos del triatlón de Venice Beach para los Juegos Olímpicos de 2028
items.author: Rory Carroll
items.creator: Rory Carroll
items.summary: Los organizadores de Los Ángeles 2028 dieron a conocer el miércoles los recorridos preliminares de triatlón para los Juegos Olímpicos y Paralímpicos, situando las pruebas en Venice Beach con una línea de meta común con vistas al océano Pacífico.
items.body:
Los organizadores de Los Ángeles 2028 dieron a conocer el miércoles los recorridos preliminares de triatlón para los Juegos Olímpicos y Paralímpicos, situando las pruebas en Venice Beach con una línea de meta común con vistas al océano Pacífico.
Los recorridos, que aún están sujetos a pruebas operativas, contarán con una zona de transición central cerca de la playa, lo que permitirá a los espectadores ver cómo los atletas pasan de la natación al ciclismo y a la carrera a pie.
Los organizadores afirmaron que los recorridos de ciclismo y carrera a pie, en general llanos, se han diseñado para favorecer un ritmo de carrera rápido.
El triatlón individual femenino de los Juegos está programado para el 15 de julio y será la primera prueba en la que se entregarán medallas de LA28. La carrera individual masculina tendrá lugar al día siguiente, y el relevo mixto está previsto para el 20 de julio.
En las pruebas individuales, los competidores comienzan con un recorrido de natación en el océano de 1,5 kilómetros, entrando al agua directamente desde la playa en lugar de desde un pontón. La prueba de natación constará de una vuelta de 1.000 metros, seguida de una breve carrera por la playa y una segunda vuelta de 500 m.
A continuación, los atletas completarán ocho vueltas de 5 kilómetros en bicicleta, que incluirán tramos por la ciclovía de Venice Beach y por las calles de la ciudad, antes de una carrera a pie de cuatro vueltas y 10 km que cruzará los puentes de la zona de los canales de Venice.
El relevo mixto contará con equipos de cuatro atletas que competirán en un orden alterno de mujer-hombre-mujer-hombre. Cada atleta nadará 350 m, recorrerá 6,6 km en bicicleta y correrá 1,6 km antes de pasar el relevo a un compañero de equipo.
Las pruebas individuales paralímpicas, previstas para los días 18 y 19 de agosto de 2028, incluirán un recorrido de natación de 750 m con salida desde una barcaza situada más allá del rompeolas, seguido de un recorrido en bicicleta de 20 km y una carrera a pie de 5 km. Las pruebas contarán con atletas de seis categorías deportivas.
LA28 ha indicado que los recorridos se pondrán a prueba durante una prueba del Circuito Mundial de Triatlón T50 de la World Triathlon, que se celebrará del 16 al 18 de julio de 2027.

items.title: Dramatic eviction of 87-year-old Madrid tenant spotlights Spain's housing crisis
items.author: Corina Pons
items.creator: Corina Pons
items.summary: Police evicted an 87-year-old woman on Wednesday from her Madrid home of more than seven decades despite hundreds of people protesting outside and the government criticising the eviction order, in a dramatic new flashpoint of Spain's housing crisis.
items.body:
Police evicted an 87-year-old woman on Wednesday from her Madrid home of more than seven decades despite hundreds of people protesting outside and the government criticising the eviction order, in a dramatic new flashpoint of Spain's housing crisis.
After being given just 30 minutes to leave with only essential belongings, Maricarmen Abascal was eventually removed from the building on a stretcher accompanied by social services officials and driven away in an ambulance as supporters chanted "Maricarmen, you're not alone!" and "Murderers!"
The case highlights mounting pressure on long-term tenants in major Spanish cities, where soaring rents, gentrification and a shortage of affordable housing have fuelled social and political tensions.
The apartment in the capital's affluent Retiro neighbourhood had been acquired by an investment fund that sought a steep increase in her rent.
Maricarmen's lawyer, Beatriz Duro, said court officials and representatives of the investment fund, Urbagestion, had refused to suspend the eviction despite a pending court filing, humanitarian appeals and evidence that public authorities were working to secure alternative accommodation.
Urbagestion did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Duro said an anonymous individual had offered to cover the rent payments, but the landlord declined to sign a new lease.
"I've lived here for 71 years and I don't want to leave," Maricarmen told reporters on the eve of the eviction.
The eviction sparked tense scenes outside the building, where police forcibly removed protesters blocking the entrance. Reuters witnesses saw officers dragging and pushing demonstrators, lifting some by their arms and legs as they cleared the doorway.
Spain remains divided over how to tackle a worsening housing affordability crisis.
The left-wing coalition government has pushed for stronger tenant protections and wider rent controls, but has struggled to secure backing in a divided parliament, while the conservative-led Madrid regional government has favoured a more market-oriented approach.
Madrid's regional leader, Isabel Diaz Ayuso, is embroiled in a scandal regarding her government's purchase, via a public real estate agency, of a €6.3 million ($7.2 million) luxury penthouse. The opposition accuses Ayuso of seeking to use the property as her personal residence while bypassing public spending and transparency rules, which she denies.
Referring to that scandal, activists at Wednesday's eviction shouted: "Ayuso's penthouse for Maricarmen!"
($1 = 0.8763 euros)

items.title: Seleccionador de Irlanda agradece al primer ministro su apoyo de cara a los partidos contra Israel
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El seleccionador de Irlanda, Heimir Hallgrimsson, agradeció el apoyo del primer ministro del país después de que sus comentarios recibieran una contundente respuesta por parte de la Federación Israelí de Fútbol, mientras los próximos partidos entre ambas naciones siguen acaparando los titulares.
items.body:
El seleccionador de Irlanda, Heimir Hallgrimsson, agradeció el apoyo del primer ministro del país después de que sus comentarios recibieran una contundente respuesta por parte de la Federación Israelí de Fútbol, mientras los próximos partidos entre ambas naciones siguen acaparando los titulares.
El equipo de Hallgrimsson se enfrentará a Kosovo el jueves en su primer partido de la Liga de Naciones, pero ese encuentro pasó a un segundo plano en lo que respecta al interés de los medios de comunicación y del público.
El partido del domingo contra Israel, que se disputará a domicilio, tendrá lugar en terreno neutral, en Debrecen (Hungría), ante un reducido número de aficionados israelíes. La Federación de Fútbol de Irlanda (FAI) trasladó el partido en casa, previsto para el 4 de octubre, a Serbia. Ese encuentro se jugará a puerta cerrada.
El fin de semana, Hallgrimsson afirmó: "No jugamos con el genocidio, jugamos contra el genocidio", y el lunes la Federación Israelí de Fútbol respondió: "No jugamos con la ignorancia, la hipocresía y la estupidez, jugamos contra el entrenador que las encarna".
El primer ministro irlandés, Micheal Martin, defendió a Hallgrimsson al hablar con los periodistas el martes, calificando las declaraciones de Israel de "inaceptables" y añadiendo que "Israel no puede seguir negando lo que el mundo sabe".
La rueda de prensa del miércoles previa al partido contra Kosovo comenzó con una pregunta sobre los comentarios del primer ministro.
"Lo que dije en la última rueda de prensa ha desviado la atención de lo que quizá sea lo más importante: vamos a disputar un partido importante contra Kosovo", afirmó Hallgrimsson.
"Quizá, desde el punto de vista del liderazgo, no haya sido muy acertado por mi parte desviar la atención de esta manera. Pero, para responder a la pregunta, estamos agradecidos por todo el apoyo que recibimos. Es un momento delicado para nosotros", comentó.
Irlanda ha sido uno de los críticos más abiertos de Europa respecto a la guerra de Israel en Gaza, y los miembros de la FAI votaron en noviembre a favor de que su junta directiva solicitara a la UEFA la suspensión de Israel de las competiciones europeas.
El ataque de Israel a Gaza ha sido calificado de genocidio por expertos de la ONU y organizaciones de derechos humanos, una acusación que Israel rechaza.
Se han producido numerosas protestas en Irlanda en los días previos a los partidos y el miércoles se le preguntó al capitán Dara O’Shea si los jugadores tenían prevista alguna acción para los partidos contra Israel.
"Nos reuniremos el viernes para debatirlo en grupo", afirmó O’Shea. "No creo que estuviéramos haciendo bien nuestro trabajo si no nos centráramos en el partido (contra Kosovo). Es algo que no se puede pasar por alto. La decisión a la que lleguemos como jugadores se tomará de forma unánime".
La cadena pública irlandesa RTE, que tiene la obligación contractual de retransmitir los partidos, ofrecerá una cobertura reducida. No habrá presentación en estudio ni análisis de expertos, y los comentarios se tomarán de la señal internacional. La RTE no ha aceptado publicidad ni patrocinios para ninguno de los dos partidos.

items.title: Musk elogia Xi como grande líder em entrevista à televisão estatal chinesa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente-executivo da Tesla, Elon Musk, elogiou o presidente chinês Xi Jinping como um “grande líder” em declarações feitas durante uma entrevista à rede de televisão estatal chinesa CCTV na quarta-feira.
items.body:
O presidente-executivo da Tesla, Elon Musk, elogiou o presidente chinês Xi Jinping como um “grande líder” em declarações feitas durante uma entrevista à rede de televisão estatal chinesa CCTV na quarta-feira.
“Sob sua gestão, a China prosperou imensamente”, disse Musk, citando o progresso visível nos novos edifícios e nas infraestruturas construídas no país.
“Também é óbvio perceber, simplesmente andando pelas ruas, o aumento da prosperidade do cidadão chinês comum”, acrescentou ele.
Musk deve se juntar a outros executivos dos EUA em um jantar de Estado na Casa Branca oferecido pelo presidente Donald Trump em homenagem a Xi na quinta-feira, informou a Reuters.
Xi vai se reunir com Trump na quinta-feira na segunda cúpula deste ano entre os líderes das duas maiores economias do mundo.
Musk também comentou sobre o maior centro de produção da Tesla, localizado em Xangai, descrevendo a equipe como “incrivelmente talentosa, trabalhadora e confiável”.
“A fábrica da Tesla em Xangai é uma joia e é linda”, disse ele.
Musk já havia descartado especulações de que as operações da Tesla na China poderiam ser separadas antes de uma possível fusão com a SpaceX.
As vendas dos veículos Model 3 e Model Y produzidos na fábrica da Tesla em Xangai — que também é seu maior centro de exportação global — aumentaram 3,6% na comparação anual em agosto, apresentando uma desaceleração acentuada em relação ao mês anterior, à medida que tendências divergentes persistiram nos principais mercados da montadora norte-americana.

items.title: BCE dice que la UE podría recuperar un tercio de la ventaja económica de EEUU con mayores empresas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Unión Europea podría reducir un tercio de su brecha de productividad con Estados Unidos si contara con el mismo número de grandes empresas, según afirmó el miércoles el Banco Central Europeo, sumándose así a las peticiones de reformas que faciliten el crecimiento de las compañías.
items.body:
La Unión Europea podría reducir un tercio de su brecha de productividad con Estados Unidos si contara con el mismo número de grandes empresas, según afirmó el miércoles el Banco Central Europeo, sumándose así a las peticiones de reformas que faciliten el crecimiento de las compañías.
Los responsables políticos europeos están tratando de hacer frente al bajo rendimiento económico de la UE en comparación con Estados Unidos, donde se encuentran muchas de las empresas más grandes del mundo y que lidera la carrera por el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial.
Según estudios académicos, los trabajadores de la UE producen un 20% menos por hora que sus homólogos estadounidenses. En 1995, ambos estaban prácticamente a la par.
Los expertos del BCE constataron que, si Europa tuviera la misma distribución de grandes y pequeñas compañías que Estados Unidos —sin modificar la productividad de cada tipo de empresa—, la brecha de productividad se reduciría en cerca de un tercio.
Las grandes empresas son mucho más productivas que las pequeñas. Las que tienen al menos 250 empleados generan una media de 86.800 euros de valor añadido por trabajador al año, mientras que de menos de 10 empleados producen menos de la mitad de esa cantidad.
El BCE señaló que los peores resultados de Europa en materia de productividad también reflejan un menor nivel de innovación, una regulación fragmentada y unos mercados de capitales menos desarrollados, factores que dificultan el crecimiento de las empresas y su capacidad para competir a nivel internacional.
El banco central respaldó el marco propuesto "EU Inc", un régimen de derecho mercantil a escala del bloque destinado a reducir las barreras a la actividad empresarial transfronteriza.
Inspirándose vagamente en el marco societario de Delaware (Estados Unidos), EU Inc crearía una estructura jurídica única que operaría en todo el bloque, eludiendo el mosaico de 27 sistemas nacionales de derecho de sociedades y docenas de formas jurídicas.
"EU Inc. tiene el potencial de reforzar el Mercado Único, potenciando la competencia, la innovación y el crecimiento de la productividad", afirmó el BCE.

items.title: Número de mortos em naufrágio aumenta na Indonésia e seguem buscas por 107 desaparecidos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O número de mortos no naufrágio de um navio de passageiros que virou e afundou na costa da Indonésia há 10 dias subiu para 28 nesta quarta-feira, segundo autoridades, e as equipes de resgate esperam encontrar mais corpos à medida que ampliam as buscas subaquáticas.
items.body:
O número de mortos no naufrágio de um navio de passageiros que virou e afundou na costa da Indonésia há 10 dias subiu para 28 nesta quarta-feira, segundo autoridades, e as equipes de resgate esperam encontrar mais corpos à medida que ampliam as buscas subaquáticas.
A balsa Virgo Transport 8 transportava 243 pessoas, incluindo 30 tripulantes e um número desconhecido de veículos, quando virou devido ao mau tempo na madrugada de 13 de setembro, durante uma viagem de Surabaya, em Java Oriental, para Banjarmasin, em Kalimantan do Sul.
Membros da Guarda Costeira e da Marinha recuperaram 16 corpos de dentro do navio nos últimos três dias, sendo que nove foram encontrados nesta quarta-feira. Mais dois corpos foram levados pela correnteza até a costa a cerca de 253 km do local do acidente, informou o chefe da Agência Nacional de Resgate, Mohammad Syafii.
Até quarta-feira, o número total confirmado de mortos era de 28, com 107 pessoas ainda desaparecidas. Havia 108 sobreviventes confirmados.
As operações de busca e resgate foram prorrogadas até 27 de setembro. As autoridades informaram que os esforços para endireitar o navio estavam em andamento, mas ele continuava virado na quarta-feira.

items.title: Aumentan a 28 los muertos de naufragio de barco en Indonesia, se amplía búsqueda de 107 desaparecidos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El número de muertos del naufragio de un buque de pasajeros que se hundió frente a las costas de Indonesia hace 10 días ascendió el miércoles a 28, informaron las autoridades, y los equipos de rescate prevén encontrar más cadáveres a medida que amplían la búsqueda submarina.
items.body:
El número de muertos del naufragio de un buque de pasajeros que se hundió frente a las costas de Indonesia hace 10 días ascendió el miércoles a 28, informaron las autoridades, y los equipos de rescate prevén encontrar más cadáveres a medida que amplían la búsqueda submarina.
El transbordador "Virgo Transport 8" llevaba a 243 personas, entre ellas 30 tripulantes y un número indeterminado de vehículos, cuando zozobró debido al mal tiempo en la madrugada del 13 de septiembre, durante un trayecto desde Surabaya, en Java Oriental, hasta Banjarmasin, en Kalimantan del Sur.
El personal de la guardia costera y de la Armada ha recuperado 16 cadáveres del interior del barco en los últimos tres días, nueve de ellos hallados el miércoles. Otros dos cadáveres habían sido arrastrados hasta la costa a unos 253 km (157 millas) del lugar del accidente, dijo el director de la Agencia Nacional de Rescate, Mohammad Syafii.
Hasta el miércoles, el número total de fallecidos confirmados ascendía a 28, con 107 personas aún desaparecidas. Se contabilizaban 108 supervivientes.
Las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate se han prolongado hasta el 27 de septiembre. Las autoridades indicaron que se estaban llevando a cabo esfuerzos para enderezar el barco, pero este seguía volcado el miércoles.
La búsqueda del miércoles se centró en localizar más cadáveres en los camarotes del barco, explicó I Putu Sudayana, jefe de la agencia de rescate de Banjarmasin.
Los buzos rompieron las ventanas de los camarotes el martes, pero no pudieron entrar debido a la turbidez del agua y a las fuertes corrientes, lo que hizo imposible recuperar los cadáveres que se habían avistado.
"Nuestra búsqueda submarina se centra en el casco del barco. Ahí es donde estamos concentrando nuestros esfuerzos porque hemos encontrado a muchos pasajeros atrapados dentro de los camarotes", afirmó.
Posteriormente, si es posible, los equipos de rescate trasladarán la búsqueda a los vehículos que se encontraban en el transbordador, aunque esto podría resultar complicado, ya que muchos parecen estar amontonados unos encima de otros.
"Esto supone un riesgo para el equipo de buceo", señaló Putu. "Si es factible y seguro, llevaremos a cabo la búsqueda".

items.title: Bce: Ue potrebbe recuperare un terzo del vantaggio economico Usa con più grandi imprese
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'Unione europea potrebbe colmare un terzo del proprio divario di produttività rispetto agli Stati Uniti se disponesse dello stesso numero di grandi imprese.
items.body:
L'Unione europea potrebbe colmare un terzo del proprio divario di produttività rispetto agli Stati Uniti se disponesse dello stesso numero di grandi imprese.
Lo ha affermato la Banca centrale europea, unendosi al coro di richieste per riforme volte a facilitare la crescita delle imprese.
Gli esponenti politici europei stanno cercando di affrontare la sottoperformance economica dell’Ue in confronto con gli Stati Uniti, dove hanno sede molte delle più grandi aziende del mondo e in testa alla corsa per lo sviluppo dell’intelligenza artificiale.
Secondo alcuni studi accademici, i lavoratori dell’Unione producono il 20% in meno all’ora rispetto alle controparti statunitensi, mentre nel 1995 i livelli erano quasi equivalenti.
Gli esperti della Bce hanno rilevato che se l’Europa avesse la stessa distribuzione di grandi e piccole imprese degli Stati Uniti – senza modificare il livello di produttività di ciascuna tipologia di azienda – il divario di produttività si ridurrebbe di circa un terzo.
La produttività delle grandi imprese è nettamente maggiore di quelle più piccole: le aziende con almeno 250 dipendenti generano in media 86.800 euro di valore aggiunto per lavoratore all’anno, mentre quelle con meno di 10 dipendenti ne producono meno della metà.
La Bce ha affermato che i più deboli risultati dell’Europa in termini di produttività riflettono anche una minore innovazione, una regolamentazione frammentata e mercati dei capitali meno sviluppati, tutti fattori che rendono più difficile per le imprese crescere e competere su scala internazionale.
La banca centrale ha sostenuto il quadro proposto denominato "EU Inc", un regime di diritto societario a livello europeo volto a ridurre le barriere all’attività commerciale transfrontaliera.
Ispirato liberamente al quadro societario del Delaware negli Stati Uniti, l’EU Inc. andrebbe a creare un’unica struttura giuridica operante in tutta l'Unione, aggirando la frammentazione data dai 27 sistemi nazionali di diritto societario e decine di forme d'impresa.
"EU Inc. ha il potenziale per sostenere il Mercato Unico, rafforzando la concorrenza, l’innovazione e la crescita della produttività", ha affermato la Bce.

items.title: Glencore to create US strategic critical minerals reserve with EXIM Bank
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Glencore on Wednesday said it received a $500 million commitment from Export-Import Bank of the United States to create a strategic critical minerals reserve to strengthen supply chains in the US.
items.body:
Glencore (GLEN.L) on Wednesday said it received a $500 million commitment from Export-Import Bank of the United States to create a strategic critical minerals reserve to strengthen supply chains in the US.
VaultCo, the public-private partnership between the global miner and the US government agency, will enable Glencore to source, procure, and deliver critical minerals to the US, and reduce any future disruptions to the country's supply of critical minerals, the company said.

items.title: HSBC lifts STOXX 600 year-end target on stronger earnings outlook
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: HSBC lifted its year-end target for Europe's STOXX 600 index for the first time this year on Wednesday, citing stronger earnings growth prospects, improving business sentiment and a healthier economic outlook.
items.body:
HSBC lifted its year-end target for Europe's STOXX 600 index (.STOXX) for the first time this year on Wednesday, citing stronger earnings growth prospects, improving business sentiment and a healthier economic outlook.
The brokerage expects the index to reach 680 points by year-end from its previous forecast of 670, implying about 6.3% upside from current levels, and to reach 760 by the end of next year.
HSBC is the latest brokerage to turn more optimistic on European equities, as investors look past geopolitical risks and focus on the region's ability to withstand recent economic and energy shocks.
Recent data have also eased concerns that [USN:L6N45F0DA TEXT:"geopolitical tensions"] would significantly derail growth.
London-based HSBC forecasts European earnings growth of 15.6% in 2026 and 15.4% in 2027.
The brokerage said European companies are becoming increasingly domestically focused, with regional revenue exposure rising to its highest level since 2017, somewhat shielding them from currency movements even as overseas sales still account for about half of revenue.
A weakness of the euro and other European currencies against the US dollar could provide an additional tailwind for corporate profits, HSBC added.
The brokerage upgraded Italy to "overweight" from "neutral", citing lower reliance on Middle Eastern gas imports, while downgrading France to "underweight" on weaker economic forecasts and deteriorating consensus estimates.
HSBC also raised its year-end target for Britain's FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) to 11,390 from 10,980, implying nearly 6.5% upside from current levels.

14.05 - Un elicottero militare russo Mi-8 ha effettuato una breve incursione nello spazio aereo della Polonia, Paese membro della Nato, partendo dall’exclave russa di Kaliningrad.
Lo ha reso noto il Comando operativo dell’esercito polacco.
L’elicottero ha trascorso 42 secondi nello spazio aereo polacco, penetrando fino ad una estensione di circa 300 metri, ha scritto il Comando su X.
"Sono stati fatti decollare aerei da caccia, mentre le forze e i mezzi di terra sono rimasti in stato di allerta. La natura dell’episodio indica che la Russia sta ancora una volta mettendo alla prova la prontezza della nostra difesa aerea", ha aggiunto
11.35 - Il Cremlino ha affermato oggi che non sussistono ancora i presupposti per l’avvio di colloqui di pace sull’Ucraina, pur rimanendo aperto a tali trattative.
Intervenendo in vista di un incontro previsto a New York tra il segretario di Stato Usa Marco Rubio e il ministro degli Esteri russo Sergey Lavrov, ha detto che non vi sono piani concreti per incontri ad alto livello né con Washington né con Kiev al fine di discutere un potenziale accordo di pace.
Il portavoce del Cremlino Dmitry Peskov ha affermato che non è cambiata nemmeno la posizione della Russia riguardo alla possibilità di un incontro di persona tra il presidente Vladimir Putin e il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky.
"Zelensky, se lo desidera, può venire a Mosca. Gli saranno fornite le necessarie garanzie di sicurezza", ha detto Peskov, aggiungendo che il presidente ucraino è consapevole delle decisioni che deve prendere, secondo Mosca.
Le autorità ucraine hanno ripetutamente affermato che un incontro a Mosca non sarebbe accettabile e hanno proposto invece di tenere colloqui diretti in un paese neutrale.

items.title: Analysis-There's a reason Trump is the only one talking about 1% interest rates
items.author: By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage
items.summary: By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage WASHINGTON, Sept 23 (Reuters) - As a lifelong real estate investor whose businesses relied on debt and interest rates, P...
items.body:
Analysis-There's a reason Trump is the only one talking about 1% interest rates

FILE PHOTO: View of the facade as construction continues on the Federal Reserve Board building, in Washington, D.C., U.S., September 17, 2025. REUTERS/Ken Cedeno/File Photo · Reuters
By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage
Wed, September 23, 2026 at 8:37 AM EDT 5 min read

By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage
WASHINGTON, Sept 23 (Reuters) - As a lifelong real estate investor whose businesses relied on debt and interest rates, President Donald Trump might be expected to know better: The 1% rate he keeps demanding from the US Federal Reserve is impractical and would likely backfire, according to analysts.

A policy rate slashed that low, from its current range of 3.75% to 4%, would likely touch off massive dislocation in the global financial system and end up with the US government paying more to borrow than it does now in bond markets.
Some figures close to the president say his interest rate demands should be seen less as a prescription and more as a way to deflect from issues like high consumer prices ahead of midterm elections in November.
But in practical terms, a 3-percentage-point cut by the Fed "seems cataclysmic," said J. Benson Durham, founder of DASM investment research firm.
Treasury rates would climb as investors priced higher inflation, countries like Germany could soak up capital by offering just a bit more to lenders than the US, and the dollar would "plummet," he said.
Yet despite the bond market math and concerns about Fed credibility, Trump has repeatedly called for ultra-low borrowing costs, which he says the US deserves as the world's largest economy with, he argues, the safest credit.

TRUMP'S DEMANDS
After the Fed under its relatively new chair, Kevin Warsh, hiked rates last week, Trump criticized the decision and repeated the 1% figure.
"The president in his own way is saying, 'I don't like the pain of this,' but he should be clear that it's not the fault of the Fed" for having to raise rates, said Grover Norquist, head of the conservative group Americans for Tax Reform, and an outside Trump economic adviser.
Given the importance of controlling inflation ahead of the vote, some allies of the administration privately praised Warsh after the rate decision, according to one person involved in the exchanges, who requested anonymity to discuss them.
A White House ally who liaises with Warsh told Reuters the calls for 1% are unrealistic given the workings of global bond markets.
"Can everybody just wake up? If you mess up the bond market, it's good for the bond investor and no one else," said the person.
The White House did not respond to requests for comment. The Fed did not comment on Trump's remarks.

HIGH INFLATION AHEAD OF VOTE
Trump's pressure on the Fed goes beyond the 1% rate request.
He aims to oust Governor Lisa Cook, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, and is awaiting results of an inspector general's probe of former Chair Jerome Powell's oversight of a Fed construction project. Powell remains a Fed governor, denying Trump a new appointee at the central bank.

Story Continues
Some analysts say the Fed remains a useful scapegoat for Trump, who heads into the midterms with mortgage rates nearing 7% and prices for staples like ground beef and gasoline also rising, underlining the issue of affordability.
Inflation has increased since early in Trump's term from the combined shocks of his tariffs and energy costs from the US war with Iran, among other things.
The Fed's preferred inflation measure was 3.7% in July and the bank doesn't expect that rate to fall to a 2% target before 2029, suggesting inflation could remain elevated for Trump's entire term.

TONE SHIFT
The president's public comments have mostly spared Warsh, his handpicked successor to Powell, and focused more on the Fed's other policymakers.
When Powell as chair ignored Trump's various calls to cut rates or not raise them, the president called him an "enemy," a "numb skull" and other epithets.
By contrast last week, Trump characterized Warsh as being boxed in by a "political" board. After the Fed lifted rates for the first time in three years, in a unanimous vote, Trump said that he had told Warsh in a phone call beforehand to go along with the majority if necessary.
Warsh has said he won't discuss conversations with Trump.
Long considered an inflation hawk, Warsh had weeks ago laid out the case for higher rates, surprising some analysts who had questioned his independence from Trump.
Warsh "has repeatedly said the Fed will deliver price stability. Wednesday's rate hike shows that he means it," Apollo Global Chief Economist Torsten Slok said after the Fed's Sept. 16 decision.

KEEPING AN OPEN LINE
The relative leeway Trump is giving Warsh may reflect their warmer ties early in the new Fed chief's term.
Trump started chiding Powell early in his first presidency for raising rates, and the relationship remained tense. Powell did not openly push back against the rhetoric until early this year, when the administration sent a grand jury subpoena over the construction project.
Warsh appears to have a more congenial relationship, fielding the president's phone calls while maintaining he'll remain an independent broker when it comes to monetary policy.
That policy now includes a hardening stance against inflation.
Polls show that pocketbook issues including record diesel fuel prices are hitting red state rural economies and small businesses, and that Trump's record-low approval rating is dragging down Republican congressional candidates.
A Reuters/IPSOS poll published Monday showed just 17% of respondents approve of the president's handling of the cost-of-living, the top issue Americans say will influence how they vote in six weeks.
(Reporting by Howard Schneider; Editing by Dan Burns and Jonathan Spicer)

Sept 23 : India government-backed 48.50 billion rupees ($506.58 million) line of credit to the Maldives became effective on August 27, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India said on Wednesday, paving the way for individual project-level credit agreements under the facility.
Here are some details:

• Under the agreement, at least 75 per cent of the value of goods, works and services under contracts financed through the facility must be supplied by sellers from India, while the remaining 25 per cent may be sourced from outside India.

Sept 23 : India government-backed 48.50 billion rupees ($506.58 million) line of credit to the Maldives became effective on August 27, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India said on Wednesday, paving the way for individual project-level credit agreements under the facility.
Here are some details:
• The RBI said that the facility will be deployed through individual credit agreements with minimum value of 5 billion rupees each
• Under the agreement, at least 75 per cent of the value of goods, works and services under contracts financed through the facility must be supplied by sellers from India, while the remaining 25 per cent may be sourced from outside India.

items.title: Civil society groups urge Malaysia to stop Rohingya returns
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: More than 160 civil society organisations released a joint statement on Wednesday urging Malaysia to halt plans to deport Rohingya refugees to Myanmar, citing severe risks of ongoing violence and forced conscription.
items.body:
More than 160 civil society organisations released a joint statement on Wednesday urging Malaysia to halt plans to deport Rohingya refugees to Myanmar, citing severe risks of ongoing violence and forced conscription.
The groups expressed "grave concerns" over Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's proposal to seek Myanmar junta leader-turned-president Min Aung Hlaing's cooperation to send back Rohingya, a Muslim-minority community long persecuted in Myanmar.
The Malaysian government was not immediately available for comment.
Malaysia had around [USN:L4N44E069 TEXT:"193,800 refugees"] from Myanmar - including large numbers of Rohingya - as of February, according to the United Nations and the country says it plans to return 1,500 refugees on September 29 in a [USN:L6N44O0RX TEXT:"first phase"].
Malaysia [USN:L6N4580O7 TEXT:"said"] Myanmar has agreed to take back 5,000 refugees without specifying if they were Rohingya.
Anwar has [USN:L6N4580O7 TEXT:"said"] he plans to invite Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing to Malaysia in return for accepting Rohingya refugees.
The statement said Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing is the "architect of genocide" against Rohingya for the military crackdown on the community, with the International Criminal Court currently weighing an arrest warrant against him.
Myanmar, which does not recognize Rohingya as an ethnic group, has previously said its military actions in Rakhine state that drove out large numbers of Rohingya were in response to militant attacks.
The groups warned that upon returning to Myanmar, Rohingya could face forced conscription into multiple armed groups, including the military, the Arakan Army (AA), and the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA).
Thousands of persecuted Rohingya flee Myanmar each year, often risking dangerous journeys on rickety boats and overland routes.
Myanmar's military is [USN:L1N3XH0H5 TEXT:"fighting"] the Arakan Army, an ethnic armed group based in Rakhine state — from where large numbers of Rohingya have been driven out — that is seeking greater autonomy for the region.
items.raw_description: More than 160 civil society organisations released a joint statement on Wednesday urging Malaysia to halt plans to deport Rohingya refugees to Myanmar, citing severe risks of ongoing violence and forced conscription.

items.title: UBS BB reitera compra para ação da Petrobras e eleva preço-alvo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Analistas do UBS BB elevaram o preço-alvo para as ações da Petrobras para R$62 ante R$60 e reiteraram recomendação de compra para os papéis, citando que a tese de investimento na companhia se destaca sob as perspectivas macro e micro.
items.body:
Analistas do UBS BB elevaram o preço-alvo para as ações da Petrobras (PETR3.SA) para R$62 ante R$60 e reiteraram recomendação de compra para os papéis, citando que a tese de investimento na companhia se destaca sob as perspectivas macro e micro.
Tasso Vasconcellos e equipe chamaram a atenção para a elevada exposição ao petróleo, beneficiada pelo fato de a companhia ser exportadora líquida, sem grandes impactos operacionais decorrentes dos conflitos no Oriente Médio, enquanto a produção tem surpreendido positivamente, com o ritmo atual à frente do plano da estatal.
Eles ponderaram que o negócio de refino ainda está abaixo dos níveis que gostariam de ver -- entre pares da América Latina, América do Norte e Europa, no segundo trimestre, a Petrobras foi a única empresa que apresentou queda trimestral no Ebitda por barril no segmento --, mas apontaram que o programa de subsídios do governo oferece algum suporte.
Tais elementos, combinados com uma política clara de dividendos trimestrais diretamente vinculada ao fluxo de caixa, resultam em um yield de dividendo de 10% a 11% em 2026, aumentando para 13% a 14% em 2027, colocando a Petrobras "entre as empresas com maiores yields de dividendos entre seus pares globais e sustentando nossa perspectiva positiva", afirmaram em relatório a clientes com data de terça-feira.
Na véspera, as ações preferenciais da Petrobras fecharam a R$48,35 e os papéis ordinários foram cotados a R$53,20. Em 2026, ambos acumulam valorizações de 66,76% e 72,55%, respectivamente.

items.title: India tightens proposal to roll out food warning labels for packaged products
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India's food safety authority on Wednesday tightened its proposed warning labels for packaged products, saying they would be applicable even if one nutrient of concern – salt, sugar or fat – was high, according to a court filing seen by Reuters.
items.body:
India's food safety authority on Wednesday tightened its proposed warning labels for packaged products, saying they would be applicable even if one nutrient of concern – salt, sugar or fat – was high, according to a court filing seen by Reuters.
Earlier, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India had said it would roll out the red warning labels over two phases, with the first phase only triggering a warning mark when two concerning nutrients were high in quantity.
That proposal has been dropped, and the warning labels will be rolled out in a single phase now, the FSSAI told India's Supreme Court, which is hearing pleas of health activists.
The filing is not public but was seen by Reuters.

items.title: Yu completes hat-trick of gold in fairytale Asian Games debut
items.author: Amlan Chakraborty
items.creator: Amlan Chakraborty
items.summary: Three golds in three events, each with a benchmark timing — the script could not have been written any better for Chinese swimming sensation Yu Zidi, who capped her fairytale Asian Games debut in style on Wednesday.
items.body:
Three golds in three events, each with a benchmark timing — the script could not have been written any better for Chinese swimming sensation Yu Zidi, who capped her fairytale Asian Games debut in style on Wednesday.
Having already shaken the swimming world by winning the 200m butterfly and 200m individual medley, the 13-year-old erased any lingering doubts about her generational talent with a dominant victory in the 400m individual medley, further tightening China's grip on the medals table.
Yu's wire-to-wire win, clocked at four minutes and 28.56 seconds, set a new Games record and came comfortably 3.95 seconds ahead of compatriot Ke Wenxi.
"I am very happy. I have gained a lot from these Asian Games, but there are also some regrets," Yu said.
"I will go back and review what I did not do well. Hopefully, I can do better next time."
China's butterfly queen Zhang Yufei was the latest to gush about Yu, who is already tipped for a duel with Canadian Summer McIntosh at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
"I've only seen her at the National Games so far but seeing her results get better and better it makes me really happy," Zhang told Reuters.
"I also hope this little girl can maintain her trajectory... It will be interesting to see how high she can go.
"I think everyone's been surprised seeing what she has done in these two years. It seems every competition she reaches a higher level. Now everyone wonders what's next?"
Elsewhere in the pool, Peng Xuwei claimed the women's 100m backstroke title, even though she was "not particularly satisfied" with how she swam, while Zhang Zhanshuo powered to victory in the men's 200m freestyle to bag his fourth gold of the ongoing Games.
PARIS REVENGE The day also brought a measure of revenge for China over Japan, [USN:L6N45F0BP TEXT:"avenging"] their defeat at the Paris Olympics two years ago after Zhang Boheng produced a nerveless display on the high bar to seal the men's team gymnastics gold.
It marked the second time Zhang had turned the tables on Japan at the Aichi-Nagoya Games, having already edged out Shinnosuke Oka for the all-around title — just two years after finishing runner-up to him in Paris.
"Looking back now, I would not call Paris a regret," Zhang said.
"It was one stage in my gymnastics career. I learned a great deal there and took a great deal from it, and I used it to work on my shortcomings, right up to taking this gold medal today."
On the track, athletics powerhouse China opened their campaign in style, sweeping the half-marathon race walk.
Shi Shengji broke clear after the 10km mark and never looked back, the 19-year-old overpowering Japan's world record holder Yamanishi Toshikazu.
Yang Liujing claimed the women's gold after compatriot Jiang Yunyan, who had been running neck and neck, was penalised and demoted to bronze.
In weightlifting, North Korea's Ri Song Gum shattered three world records on her way to a third Asian Games gold.
The 28-year-old lifted 94kg in the snatch and 121kg in the clean-and-jerk for a combined total of 215kg, resetting all three benchmarks in the women's 49kg category.
"The world record and this gold medal hold great meaning for me, because of everything I poured into this competition," Ri said after securing North Korea's first gold of the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
On the road, Kazakhstan's Alexey Lutsenko bowed out of the Asian Games in style, claiming his second gold in Nagoya with victory in the men's road race.
Lutsenko, who will retire from cycling at the end of the year, had already won gold in the men's individual time trial and signs off with an impressive haul of seven Asian Games medals.

items.title: What's the latest with semiconductor export controls?
items.author: Anthony Rapa
items.creator: Anthony Rapa
items.summary: Anthony Rapa of Blank Rome LLP discusses recent developments in U.S. export controls on semiconductors for AI, covering the AI Diffusion Rule, policy shifts for China and the UAE, and remote computing challenges.
items.body:
As much of the world goes all-in on building out artificial intelligence ("AI") infrastructure, companies continue to navigate strict U.S. export controls over the advanced semiconductors and computing items that power AI.
Any company looking to set up or supply an AI data center must take into account these export controls, which can make or break a project based on the level of access to advanced chips they permit.
There have been significant twists and turns in this area of late, including:
•the Trump Administration's announcement that it would no longer enforce the Biden Administration's "AI Diffusion Rule";
•a patchwork of targeted changes regarding China's access to advanced chips;
•a significant upgrade in the export control status of the United Arab Emirates; and
•challenges associated with Chinese and other restricted parties remotely accessing computing power in third-country data centers.
This article will describe the current lay of the land under the Export Administration Regulations ("EAR") as administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security ("BIS"), cover the most recent notable developments, and provide tips for companies.
Current controls in place Despite certain twists and turns discussed below, the controls in place largely resemble those imposed by the Biden Administration in October 2023.
Specifically, advanced semiconductors and computing items that incorporate them (e.g., servers) are controlled for export, reexport, and transfer (in country) to (a) BIS Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including China and certain countries in the Middle East, among others) and (b) end users that are headquartered in, or have an ultimate parent headquartered in, a country in Country Group D:5 (including China).
The controlled items consist of:
•integrated circuits ("ICs") with a "total processing performance" ("TPP") of 1,600 or more and a "performance density" of 3.2 or more, and computers incorporating such ICs (with the strictest controls for ICs with (a) TPP of 4,800 or more, or (b) TPP of 1,600 or more and "performance density" of 5.92 or more); and
•high bandwidth memory having a "memory bandwidth density" greater than two gigabytes per second per square millimeter.
If an item is subject to a BIS licensing requirement, then depending on the destination and the end user, a transaction can be subject to a licensing presumption of approval or denial, or case-by-case consideration. Transactions with Country Group D:5 companies or D:5-headquartered companies generally are subject to a presumption of denial.
There are also EAR license exceptions available, including License Exceptions Notified Advanced Computing ("NAC") and Advanced Computing Authorized ("ACA").
These permit certain license-free transactions involving less-sensitive controlled items, as well as sensitive items that are not designed or marketed for use in a data center, either with prior notice to BIS (under NAC, for transactions involving D:5 recipients or D:5-headquartered recipients) or without notice (under ACA, for non-D:5 transactions).
Regarding NAC, however, in practice it is not clear whether BIS actually is processing NAC notifications.
Finally, it should be noted that the EAR also set out significant controls relating to exports, reexports, and transfers (in country) of semiconductor manufacturing equipment or otherwise in support of integrated circuit or supercomputer development or production in China and other D:5 countries, along with U.S. person support for such activities, although these measures are beyond the scope of this article.
Whither the AI Diffusion Rule? Any company seeking to operate in this landscape must take into account the "AI Diffusion Rule" and its current status under the EAR as administered by the Trump Administration.
Specifically, in January 2025, in the final days of the Biden Administration, BIS issued the AI Diffusion Rule, which overhauled the above controls to impose a worldwide export licensing requirement for the relevant controlled items, as compared to controls limited to Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5.
With this worldwide control in place, the rule then provided for the "diffusion" of controlled items through various newly issued license exceptions, countrywide computing power quotas, and licensing policies. The rule also imposed controls over certain AI model weights.
The rule, which was scheduled to go into effect in May 2025, drew criticism that it was overly complex and burdensome, and various foreign governments complained that their assigned computing quotas were too low.
The Trump Administration, in response to this sentiment, announced in May 2025 that it would not enforce the rule, and eventually would rescind it. As of this time, the rescission still has not taken place, although in May 2026 the Administration reiterated its position that it would not enforce the rule and clarified that licensing requirements remain in effect for Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5, as well as D:5-headquartered companies.
Overall, for companies seeking to comply with the EAR as currently enforced, it is vital to review BIS's May 2025 and May 2026 pronouncements on the AI Diffusion Rule, and to consider how to comply with the version of the EAR that the Trump Administration currently is enforcing regarding advanced computing items.
Notably, the AI Diffusion Rule remains in the Code of Federal Regulations throughout various provisions of the EAR, and a newcomer might conclude that these are the actual rules to follow. Companies should consider consulting counsel and/or using publicly available tools to run comparison versions of the EAR or view the text as in effect at an earlier date.
Changes in treatment for China China remains subject to strict controls under the advanced computing provisions of the EAR, although there have been targeted areas of relief.
First, as discussed in a March 2026 Reuters article , BIS amended the EAR to allow for case-by-case consideration of exports to China of advanced computing items under certain circumstances.
Specifically, this policy can apply where the exporter certifies the commercial availability of the item, the sufficiency of its U.S. domestic supply, and certain security assurances. The policy is available only for items with a TPP of less than 21,000 and a "total DRAM bandwidth" of less than 6,500 GB/s.
Second, the Trump Administration has indicated openness to licensing exports to China of H200 chips, which are less sensitive AI chips. Despite this policy, however, reports indicate that not many such licensed exports have taken place, as the Chinese government reportedly has discouraged companies from buying the chips.
Change in status for United Arab Emirates In July 2026, BIS moved the United Arab Emirates out of Country Groups D:3 and D:4 and into Country Group A:5, making it the first Arab country to enter the favorable A:5 group.
This had the effect of removing export licensing requirements for advanced computing items, although it is important to note that this favorable treatment is available only for the UAE government and for certain companies specifically identified in the EAR.
Remote computing challenges Perhaps the most notable policy challenge and hottest-button issue for companies in this area is the question of restricted parties remotely accessing advanced computing items to train AI models without actually physically receiving the chips.
For example, under this approach, a Chinese company can sign up as an infrastructure as a service ("IaaS") customer for a data center in Malaysia, which is not a restricted destination for controlled chips. In this hypothetical, the Chinese company can then train an AI model by remotely accessing the chips that it would not be permitted to receive in China without a BIS license.
BIS has not provided definitive guidance on this subject, except to issue a notice in May 2025 stating that there could be a licensing requirement to the extent that an exporter, reexport, or in-country transferor has knowledge that a Country Group D:5 party is remotely accessing computing power to train AI models for military-intelligence end uses or end users.
Notably, the application of this concept to "transferors" likely would extend to IaaS providers and data center operators that have knowledge of such military-intelligence applications.
Notably, Congress is seeking to address this issue in the Remote Access Security Act, which would give BIS authority to regulate remote access to items that are subject to the EAR. The bill passed the full House of Representatives in January 2026, although its prospects for passage by the U.S. Senate and signature by President Trump are unclear.
Compliance tips for companies Companies looking to set up or supply AI data centers should develop a compliance plan to address the most persistent challenges in this area, including:
•Understanding and operationalizing compliance around the advanced computing rules that are currently in effect;
•Conducting robust due diligence on counterparties and end users to seek to ensure that they are not headquartered in a Country Group D:5 country or ultimately owned by a D:5-based parent, including, as warranted, deep vendor-based diligence to try and penetrate opaque ownership structures;
•Securing assurances regarding the non-use of controlled items in training AI models for military-intelligence end uses or end users; and
•Planning for the possibility that BIS eventually will be empowered to regulate remote access to controlled items.

items.title: Bericht: Überprüfungsgespräch bei Volkswagen am 30. September
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Im Ringen um Einsparungen bei Volkswagen treffen sich die IG Metall und das Management nach Informationen aus Verhandlungskreisen kommende Woche zu einem ersten Gespräch. Beide Seiten kämen am 30. September in Hannover zusammen, hieß es am Mittwoch aus Verhandlungskreisen. Zuvor hatte das "Handelsblatt" über den Termin berichtet. Im Mittelpunkt stünden die Zusagen für die Werke Emden, Zwickau und Hannover, hieß es in dem Bericht.
items.body:
Im Ringen um Einsparungen bei Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) treffen sich die IG Metall und das Management nach Informationen aus Verhandlungskreisen kommende Woche zu einem ersten Gespräch. Beide Seiten kämen am 30. September in Hannover zusammen, hieß es am Mittwoch aus Verhandlungskreisen. Zuvor hatte das "Handelsblatt" über den Termin berichtet. Im Mittelpunkt stünden die Zusagen für die Werke Emden, Zwickau und Hannover, hieß es in dem Bericht.
Die IG Metall und der Betriebsrat hatten Mitte September die Revisionsklausel aus dem Tarifvertrag vom Dezember 2024 gezogen. Diese sieht Gespräche mit dem Management vor, wenn sich die Rahmenbedingungen änderten. Kommt es bei den Verhandlungen zu keiner Einigung, kann nach Gewerkschaftsangaben die Schlichtungsstelle angerufen werden.
Im Dezember 2024 hatten sich Arbeitnehmer und Vorstand nach monatelangem Ringen auf einen Tarifvertrag geeinigt. Dabei verständigten sich beide Seiten auf den Abbau von 35.000 Arbeitsplätzen. Im Gegenzug sagte der Vorstand unter anderem eine Beschäftigungsgarantie bis Ende 2030 und Modelle für die Standorte Emden, Zwickau und Hannover zu. VW-Chef Oliver Blume hat zuletzt seinen Sparkurs nochmal verschärft. Er will die Rendite bis 2030 auf neun Prozent steigern. Dazu sollen rund 50.000 Stellen weltweit wegfallen. Vier deutsche Werke stehen auf dem Prüfstand.

items.title: BCE tendrá que volver a intervenir si se producen efectos de segunda ronda en la inflación: Makhlouf
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Banco Central Europeo tendrá que volver a subir las tasas de interés si los elevados precios de la energía se trasladan a otros sectores, aunque por el momento no hay indicios de que se estén produciendo esos efectos de segunda ronda sobre la inflación, dijo el miércoles Gabriel Makhlouf, miembro del Comité de Política Monetaria del BCE.
items.body:
El Banco Central Europeo tendrá que volver a subir las tasas de interés si los elevados precios de la energía se trasladan a otros sectores, aunque por el momento no hay indicios de que se estén produciendo esos efectos de segunda ronda sobre la inflación, dijo el miércoles Gabriel Makhlouf, miembro del Comité de Política Monetaria del BCE.
"Aunque la inflación está por encima de nuestro objetivo, no estamos observando ese tipo de efectos de segunda ronda que empiecen a repercutir en los precios", declaró Makhlouf, presidente del Banco Central de Irlanda, en una entrevista concedida a la cadena nacional RTE.
"Si eso ocurre (que los precios de la energía se mantengan altos y se trasladen a otros sectores), tendremos que volver a tomar medidas para cumplir nuestro objetivo", señaló.
Makhlouf ya había advertido a principios de este mes, tras la segunda subida de las tasas del BCE este año, que elevarlas "mucho más" corre el riesgo de perjudicar el crecimiento económico.

items.title: Dutch look to Xavi to restore traditional football ethos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Dutch footballing philosophy has had a marked impact on the all-conquering success of Spain recently, but now that the Netherlands are looking to bolster their own fortunes they have turned to a Spanish World Cup winner for inspiration.
items.body:
Dutch footballing philosophy has had a marked impact on the all-conquering success of Spain recently, but now that the Netherlands are looking to bolster their own fortunes they have turned to a Spanish World Cup winner for inspiration.
Former Barcelona midfielder and coach Xavi Hernandez has become the first foreigner in charge of the Dutch national team since the 1978 World Cup.
Xavi, who as a player won the World Cup in 2010 and two European Championships, debuts as coach on Thursday when the Dutch host Germany in Amsterdam and will have three more Nations League matches in the three-week international window.
The Netherlands have turned to him for a change in perspective after spells under Ronald Koeman and Louis van Gaal sparked much disquiet over the team’s tactics and playing philosophy. Both coaches were accused of abandoning traditional Dutch values around ball possession and attacking football and employing counter-attacks as their primary weapon.
Although Van Gaal took the team to the 2022 World Cup quarter-finals and Koeman the semis of Euro 2024, elimination in the round of 32 at this year’s World Cup was a major disappointment.
"It is about how we in the Netherlands want to play football," said former international Nigel de Jong, who, as technical director at the Dutch football association, recruited Xavi.
"That means playing dominantly and being attractive in a good way while doing so. Dominant does not always mean playing attacking football; we also want to be dominant defensively. By conceding fewer goals, we want to try to win matches."
Although the 46-year-old Xavi is a relatively inexperienced coach, the Dutch feel that as a player, he had much of what their side misses, in terms of technique, discipline and creativity.
BARCELONA INFLUENCE He also showed during his coaching tenure at Barcelona, where he won La Liga in his first season in charge, the ideas the Dutch supporters want to see from their team.
"After the first meeting, I immediately felt like going out onto the pitch. New ideas and a new way of playing football. I think it is also good for the group," said midfielder Tijjani Reijnders.
Xavi, who has a four-year contract, told a press conference on Wednesday he felt the players had bought into his game model and philosophy, which he has described as revolving around possession, position, pressing, perception, and passion.
“You need possession to win the match," he said. "You need the right positions. When you lose the ball, you have to press. And you need perception to see what is happening around you and understand the game. But without passion, you cannot play football.”
But he was also clear that winning remains the end goal.
“I think there is definitely potential in this squad,” Xavi said.

items.title: India's $507 million line of credit to Maldives effective August 27, cenbank says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India government-backed 48.50 billion rupees ($506.58 million) line of credit to the Maldives became effective on August 27, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India said on Wednesday, paving the way for individual project-level credit agreements under the facility.
items.body:
India government-backed 48.50 billion rupees ($506.58 million) line of credit to the Maldives became effective on August 27, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India said on Wednesday, paving the way for individual project-level credit agreements under the facility.
Here are some details:
The RBI said that the facility will be deployed through individual credit agreements with minimum value of 5 billion rupees each
Under the agreement, at least 75% of the value of goods, works and services under contracts financed through the facility must be supplied by sellers from India, while the remaining 25% may be sourced from outside India.
The regulator said the line of credit cannot be used to pay agency commissions on exports, adding that exporters can use their own funds for such payments.
India had agreed to provide line of credit to the Maldives in July 2025 via the Export-Import Bank to finance various developmental projects in the country.
($1 = 95.7400 Indian rupees)

items.title: BCE terá que agir novamente se surgirem efeitos de segunda ordem sobre a inflação, diz Makhlouf
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Banco Central Europeu terá que aumentar as taxas de juros novamente se os preços elevados da energia se refletirem em outros setores, mas até o momento não há sinais desses efeitos de inflação de segunda ordem, afirmou nesta quarta-feira Gabriel Makhlouf, membro do BCE.
items.body:
O Banco Central Europeu terá que aumentar as taxas de juros novamente se os preços elevados da energia se refletirem em outros setores, mas até o momento não há sinais desses efeitos de inflação de segunda ordem, afirmou nesta quarta-feira Gabriel Makhlouf, membro do BCE.
“Embora a inflação esteja acima da nossa meta, não estamos vendo o tipo de efeito de segunda ordem que começa a se refletir nos preços”, disse Makhlouf, presidente do banco central da Irlanda, em entrevista à emissora nacional RTE.
“Se isso acontecer (os preços da energia permanecerem altos e se refletirem em outros setores), teremos que tomar medidas novamente para atingir nossa meta.”
Makhlouf alertou neste mês, após o segundo aumento da taxa de juros pelo BCE neste ano, que elevar as taxas de juros “muito mais” corre o risco de prejudicar o crescimento econômico.
(Reportagem de Padraic Halpin)

items.title: ZEW-Präsident und ADAC warnen vor Nebenwirkungen von Spritpreisdeckel
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Der von der Bundesregierung geplante Spritpreisdeckel stößt zunehmend auf Kritik. Der Ökonom und Wettbewerbsexperte Achim Wambach warnte am Mittwoch vor zu starken Nebenwirkungen. "Die Erfahrungen mit der 12-Uhr-Regel mahnen zur Vorsicht", teilte der Präsident des Mannheimer Forschungsinstituts ZEW mit. Ohne überzeugende Belege, dass er wirke, sollte der Preisdeckel nicht eingeführt werden. Der ADAC forderte zudem die Abschaffung der Regel, dass nur ein Mal am Tag um 12 Uhr die Tankstellenpreise erhöht werden dürfen. Dies habe nicht den gewünschten Effekt erzielt. Ein Preisdeckel könnte auch den Wettbewerb einschränken und am Ende nicht zu niedrigeren Preisen führen.
items.body:
Der von der Bundesregierung geplante Spritpreisdeckel stößt zunehmend auf Kritik. Der Ökonom und Wettbewerbsexperte Achim Wambach warnte am Mittwoch vor zu starken Nebenwirkungen. "Die Erfahrungen mit der 12-Uhr-Regel mahnen zur Vorsicht", teilte der Präsident des Mannheimer Forschungsinstituts ZEW mit. Ohne überzeugende Belege, dass er wirke, sollte der Preisdeckel nicht eingeführt werden. Der ADAC forderte zudem die Abschaffung der Regel, dass nur ein Mal am Tag um 12 Uhr die Tankstellenpreise erhöht werden dürfen. Dies habe nicht den gewünschten Effekt erzielt. Ein Preisdeckel könnte auch den Wettbewerb einschränken und am Ende nicht zu niedrigeren Preisen führen.
Die schwarz-rote Koalition hatte sich am vergangenen Freitag wegen der zuletzt wieder stark gestiegenen Tankstellenpreise im Zuge des Nahost-Krieges auf ein [USN:L8N45A1LZ TEXT:"Entlastungspaket"] verständigt. Es sieht einen Tankrabatt von 17 Cent je Liter Benzin und Diesel in den Monaten Oktober bis Dezember vor. Zudem soll das bei dem Thema eigentlich skeptische Wirtschaftsministerium einen Gesetzentwurf für einen Preisdeckel nach dem Vorbild Luxemburgs oder Belgiens ausarbeiten, der dann ab spätestens Anfang 2027 greifen soll.
Wambach schrieb in einem Meinungsbeitrag, wenn die Rendite auf dem Markt staatlich begrenzt werde, würden Raffinerien andere Produkte herstellen, Lieferungen in andere Märkte umlenken und auch anderswo investieren. "Der Staat muss nun beurteilen, welche Beschaffungskosten angemessen sind, welche Transport- und Lagerkosten berücksichtigt werden und welche Marge den Unternehmen verbleiben soll." Preise sollten aber keine "politische Verschiebungsmasse" sein. Eine ZEW-Untersuchung zur 12-Uhr-Regel habe gezeigt, dass die Margen bei Benzin nach der Einführung kurzfristig um etwa fünf bis sechs Cent je Liter gestiegen seien.
TANKRABATT SOLL SCHON FREITAG BESCHLOSSEN WERDEN Die Regierung wollte mit der Maßnahme im Frühjahr häufige Preisveränderungen unterbinden und für mehr Transparenz sorgen. Der ADAC forderte, die Regel abzuschaffen. Sie habe die Preise keinesfalls gesenkt. Die Preisdifferenz innerhalb eines Tages sei nun noch größer. "Wer mittags nach zwölf Uhr tanken muss, hat erhebliche Zusatzkosten", so ADAC-Verkehrspräsident Peter König. Er begrüßte den Tankrabatt, der schnell wirke. "Wer täglich auf das Auto angewiesen ist, braucht jetzt Entlastung - und kann nicht darauf warten, dass irgendwann bessere Instrumente entwickelt werden."
Beim Preisdeckel bestehe das Risiko, dass der festzulegende Höchstpreis zur Orientierung für alle Anbieter werde und der Wettbewerb nachlasse, so der ADAC. Der Deckel dürfe aber nicht zu einer Verknappung des Angebots und im Extremfall zu Einschränkungen der Versorgung führen. Außerdem gebe es starke regionale Unterschiede in Deutschland - anders als in kleineren Staaten. "Ein einheitlicher Höchstpreis ist deshalb besonders anspruchsvoll."
Der Tankrabatt soll am Freitag im Bundestag und Bundesrat beschlossen werden. Die über eine Mehrheit verfügenden Bundestagsfraktionen von Union und SPD begrüßten die Neuauflage am Mittwoch im Ausschuss für Wirtschaft und Energie. Im Mai und Juni gab es bereits einen Tankrabatt, der laut Kartellamt aber nur zu etwa 80 Prozent bei den Verbrauchern ankam.
