items.title: With win over Royals, White Sox would edge closer to crowning achievement
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: After three straight 100-loss seasons, the Chicago White Sox can clinch a spot in the American League playoffs on Wednesday night.
items.body:
After three straight 100-loss seasons, the Chicago White Sox can clinch a spot in the American League playoffs on Wednesday night.
The White Sox (81-76) carry a magic number of two to earn a playoff berth as they try for a series victory against the host Kansas City Royals (67-90).
"Every night here on out, it's playoff atmosphere baseball," White Sox outfielder Randal Grichuk said.
Grichuk went 4-for-5 with a three-run home run and finished a triple shy of the cycle as Chicago outslugged Kansas City 14-11 in Tuesday's series opener.
Chase Meidroth went deep as part of a 3-for-4, five-RBI showing, and Brenton Doyle and Munetaka Murakami also homered. The White Sox improved to 9-0 this season when they hit at least four home runs.
Chicago remained one game behind the AL Central-leading Cleveland Guardians while staying three games clear of the White Sox's nearest competitor -- the Texas Rangers -- for the third and final AL wild-card spot. A White Sox win, plus a Rangers loss to the New York Mets on Wednesday, would clinch at least a wild-card spot for Chicago.
White Sox starter Anthony Kay worked just four-plus innings on Tuesday, but the offense picked up the slack with 13 hits.
Grichuk paced the attack. He is batting .373 with five doubles, a triple, three home runs and 11 RBIs in September.
"I feel good. Mechanically, I feel good. Mentally, I'm in a good spot," Grichuk said. "Hopefully, it can continue. This is when you want to be at your best, obviously. Playing meaningful games in September trying to get to October."
Kansas City has lost five straight games and eight of nine but is coming off its best offensive output in nearly a month.
Tuesday marked the first time the Royals scored double-digit runs since a 13-2 victory at Toronto on Aug. 27.
Vinnie Pasquantino belted a ninth-inning grand slam to punctuate a 3-for-5, five-RBI night. Bobby Witt Jr. added three hits and Jac Caglianone had two.
Kansas City on Wednesday will turn to right-hander Seth Lugo (7-9, 5.06 ERA), an 11-year veteran who is aiming to avoid his first career season with double-digit losses.
Lugo has worked five innings in each of his first three September starts. He took the 6-2 loss at Houston on Thursday, giving up four runs and eight hits with one walk and five strikeouts.
The Astros hit four solo home runs against Lugo, who has surrendered multiple long balls in a game six times this season.
"It sounds kind of strange, but I think his stuff was pretty crisp," Royals manager Matt Quatraro said after that game. "He just missed on a couple, and they got him on first pitches."
Lugo pitched effectively against the host White Sox on April 9 but lost 2-0 after allowing two runs (one earned) and four hits in 6 1/3 innings. He also was the losing pitcher in a 6-5 game in Chicago on May 13, giving up five runs on eight hits and two walks in five innings.
In eight career starts against the White Sox, including seven starts, Lugo is 3-2 with a 2.14 ERA over 46 1/3 innings.
Left-hander Bryan Hudson (5-4, 3.03 ERA) will serve as the opener for Chicago on Wednesday ahead of right-hander Erick Fedde (8-9, 3.90), who has worked 10 innings over two starts against the Royals this season, going 0-1 with a 2.70 ERA. The loss came on April 11, 2-0.
Fedde is 1-2 with a 2.84 ERA in five career starts vs. Kansas City covering 25 1/3 innings. He took a no-decision against the visiting Detroit Tigers on Thursday, permitting one run and four hits in 4 2/3 innings with two walks and six strikeouts in a 3-1 win.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Geely turns to 4-minute EV charging, AI in battle with BYD
items.author: Ju-min Park
items.creator: Ju-min Park
items.summary: China's Geely responded to the challenge posed by rival BYD on Wednesday with a system that can charge an EV in just four minutes, the industry's fastest speed.
items.body:
China's Geely (0175.HK) responded to the challenge posed by rival BYD (002594.SZ) on Wednesday with a system that can charge an EV in just four minutes, the industry's fastest speed.
Geely also introduced a next-generation electric vehicle battery and an upgraded Galaxy E5 pure-electric SUV as it seeks to revive sales in China, where EV sales [USN:L1N450052 TEXT:"declined"] for 11 consecutive months through August.
China's EV market has moved into a battle over technology, with automakers competing on intelligent driving systems, range and ultra-fast charging capabilities to attract buyers.
Supported by a 2.2-megawatt charging infrastructure and a high-rate battery capacity, Geely said its new setup can charge a vehicle from 10% to 70% in 4.5 minutes, and from 10% to 97% in 8 minutes and 40 seconds under normal ambient temperatures.
"Current charging speeds are already approaching the physical limit, and the marginal gains from pursuing even faster speeds in the future will become increasingly small," Geely executive Zhang Dewang told Reuters at the launch event.
To ensure stability and safety under such high power, Geely is deploying AI across cloud and on-vehicle systems.
It uses cloud-based twin simulations paired with deep-learning models deployed directly on the EV to monitor battery health, manage thermal control, and predict potential hazards.
The new technology is Geely's direct response to aggressive moves by rivals such as BYD, which have invested heavily in flash-charging and megawatt-level charging networks to ease range anxiety and win customers.
Earlier this year, BYD [USN:L1N3ZT0L3 TEXT:"unveiled"] a new generation [USN:L1N45008T TEXT:"flash-charging"] system that can charge a battery from 10% to 97% in nine minutes. It plans to build 90,000 stations by 2028, Deutsche Bank has said, citing a meeting with BYD's management.
Geely's Zhang said the broader charging ecosystem would in the future resemble traditional gasoline stations with diverse brands, adding that multi-party infrastructure development will accelerate the global rollout of fast-charging networks.

items.title: Precios del mercado mundial del gas estiman escasez prolongada por guerra en Irán, dice ejecutivo de IGU
items.author: Marwa Rashad
items.creator: Marwa Rashad
items.summary: Los mercados mundiales del gas están descontando cada vez más una escasez de suministro que se prolongará mucho más allá del invierno boreal, ya que la guerra en Irán está perturbando las exportaciones de gas natural licuado (GNL) del golfo Pérsico y complica los esfuerzos de Europa por reponer sus reservas de gas, dijo un ejecutivo de alto rango del sector.
items.body:
Los mercados mundiales del gas están descontando cada vez más una escasez de suministro que se prolongará mucho más allá del invierno boreal, ya que la guerra en Irán está perturbando las exportaciones de gas natural licuado (GNL) del golfo Pérsico y complica los esfuerzos de Europa por reponer sus reservas de gas, dijo un ejecutivo de alto rango del sector.
Esta perspectiva surge en un momento en que Europa compite con Asia por los cargamentos de GNL mientras intenta reponer las reservas antes del invierno en el hemisferio norte, en medio de la continua incertidumbre sobre el impacto del conflicto en las exportaciones de Qatar, uno de los mayores proveedores de GNL del mundo.
Los precios a futuro del gas sugieren que los operadores esperan que los valores elevados y los riesgos de suministro persistan hasta el próximo verano boreal antes de que disminuyan, según Menelaos Ydreos, secretario general de la Unión Internacional del Gas (IGU, por su sigla en inglés), cuyos miembros representan más del 90% del mercado mundial del gas.
"En estos momentos, el mercado está indicando que prevé que el conflicto se prolongue", dijo Ydreos a Reuters.
Las curvas de futuros actuales indican que los mercados esperan que la escasez continúe hasta el año que viene, lo que supone un cambio notable respecto a hace unos meses, cuando los operadores esperaban que los precios bajasen tras el invierno, señaló.
"Europa está empezando a superar a Asia en las pujas porque necesita reponer sus niveles de almacenamiento", señaló Ydreos, añadiendo que la crisis actual difiere de la crisis energética que siguió a la invasión de Ucrania por parte de Rusia en 2022, ya que está afectando a varias regiones al mismo tiempo.
"Se está produciendo una cierta destrucción de la demanda a corto plazo. La cuestión es si se recuperará una vez que todo se calme o si habrá implicaciones a más largo plazo en torno a las políticas", señaló Ydreos.
La incertidumbre se ve agravada por la prohibición prevista por Europa de importar GNL ruso a partir de enero.
Es probable que los cargamentos rusos que se dirigen actualmente a Europa encuentren compradores alternativos, posiblemente a precios más bajos. Pero cualquier interrupción de esos flujos añadiría más presión a un mercado que ya se enfrenta a preocupaciones sobre el suministro de Oriente Medio, señaló Ydreos.
Los funcionarios europeos también se debaten sobre cómo equilibrar los objetivos climáticos con la seguridad energética y la asequibilidad, señaló, y añadió que la Comisión Europea debería plantearse flexibilizar algunos requisitos de aplicación, manteniendo intactos los objetivos de reducción de emisiones.
"Estamos a favor de la normativa, pero debe ser alcanzable, práctica e incentivar el cumplimiento", afirmó. "Si la normativa va mucho más allá de eso y hace que al sector le sea extremadamente difícil cumplirla, buscarán otras regiones a las que enviar su producto".

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: Ryanair group CEO Michael O'Leary said on Wednesday the airline "will not levy a fuel surcharge" amid higher prices for jet oil, though he predicted rivals may do so, and forecast more consolidation in the sector as a result of elevated fuel costs.
items.body:
Ryanair (RYA.I) group CEO Michael O'Leary said on Wednesday the airline "will not levy a fuel surcharge" amid higher prices for jet oil, though he predicted rivals may do so, and forecast more consolidation in the sector as a result of elevated fuel costs.
He told reporters: "Most of the airlines were well hedged into the summer of 2026, and therefore we absorb the kind of shock of the much higher oil prices this summer.
"None of us will be able to absorb those much higher oil prices next year ... and it will get passed on in the form of fuel surcharges on higher airfares.
"Ryanair will not levy a fuel surcharge, but the legacy guys certainly will next summer."
O'Leary added: "I very much hope that jet (fuel) prices will rise faster into next year because that will accelerate the extent to which other airlines will fail.
"Airlines who are currently loss-making will fail. It will accelerate the consolidation of Europe into four large airlines: BA (British Airways), Lufthansa, Air France and Ryanair."

items.title: Ejército polaco dice que helicóptero militar ruso entró brevemente en espacio aéreo de Polonia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Un helicóptero militar ruso Mi-8 realizó una breve incursión en el espacio aéreo de Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, desde el enclave ruso de Kaliningrado, según informó este miércoles el Mando Operativo del Ejército polaco.
items.body:
Un helicóptero militar ruso Mi-8 realizó una breve incursión en el espacio aéreo de Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, desde el enclave ruso de Kaliningrado, según informó este miércoles el Mando Operativo del Ejército polaco.
El helicóptero permaneció 42 segundos en el espacio aéreo polaco y se adentró hasta una profundidad máxima de unos 300 metros, según se indicó en la red social X.
"Se despegaron aviones de combate y las fuerzas y medios terrestres permanecieron en estado de alerta. La naturaleza del incidente indica que Rusia está poniendo a prueba, una vez más, la preparación de nuestra defensa aérea", afirmó.
Polonia se encuentra en estado de alerta máxima ante cualquier incursión en su espacio aéreo relacionada con la guerra de Rusia en Ucrania.
La embajada rusa en Varsovia no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters sobre el incidente.

BRUSSELS, Sept 23 : Greece has proposed that European Union states should create a European Spectrum Union which could use some of the funds raised by future national sales of 6G mobile spectrum for technology investment, easing pressure on the bloc's budget.
"The potential initial financial scale could be around €12–15 billion," according to the proposal, developed by the chairman of euro zone finance ministers Kyriakos Pierrakakis and presented to EU ministers on Tuesday.
"At this stage, this is a planning assumption rather than an official valuation or forecast, and does not include any potential future contribution from selected 5G rights," it said.
If the idea is accepted by the 27 countries making up the EU, the money could help ease the problem of how to finance the EU's 2028-2034 budget, proposed at €2 trillion - the main source of financing for all of the EU's main policies.

Negotiations on the financing are tough, because the budget will have to deal with new challenges like more spending on defence and making Europe more competitive, while retaining most of the spending on old policies to support farming and cohesion.
Among other new financing options, rejected by some countries and supported by others, is using a share of the cash that EU governments get from selling CO2 emissions permits to companies and a share of the tax on goods imported into the EU that were made in countries where climate policies are weaker than in the EU.
Other options include a tax on non-collected e-waste, a share of the tobacco excise duty and an annual lump-sum contribution from large firms operating and selling in the EU.
Further proposals include a levy on extreme wealth, on digital services, online gambling and crypto asset capital gains. Ireland will now have to see which of these options, or a mix of them, has a chance to get unanimous support from all 27 EU countries by the next EU summit scheduled for October.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Victims of alleged abuse by Slovenian priest urge Pope Leo to expedite Church trial
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Five victims of alleged abuse by a prominent priest with Vatican ties urged Pope Leo on Wednesday to press for the conclusion of a nearly year-long Church trial of the cleric, saying a lengthy and secret process was denying them justice.
items.body:
Five victims of alleged abuse by a prominent priest with Vatican ties urged Pope Leo on Wednesday to press for the conclusion of a nearly year-long Church trial of the cleric, saying a lengthy and secret process was denying them justice.
In an open letter ahead of Leo's [USN:L8N45A0L5 TEXT:"four-day visit to France"], where the pope is hoping to repair the Church's standing [USN:L1N45B02J TEXT:"after abuse scandals"] there, victims of [USN:L8N4510TH TEXT:"Rev. Marko Rupnik"] said their treatment reflects poorly on the Church's commitment to helping victims.
"This is the message being conveyed ... that it is useless to report abuse to ecclesiastical authorities, because nothing happens anyway and no one will be held accountable," read the letter.
The victims said they had received no updates about the Church trial and had not been able to offer testimony.
They urged Leo to press for a fair trial "so that the judgment and its outcome, whatever it may be, will remain free of any shadow of doubt."
The Vatican press office did not immediately offer comment.
Rupnik, a Slovenian priest, is a religious artist whose mosaics adorn about 200 churches and chapels around the world, including a basilica in Lourdes, France, where the pope will visit on Saturday.
The bishop of Lourdes has ordered that the mosaics be covered up for the pope's visit.
More than 20 women, mostly former nuns, have accused Rupnik of sexual and psychological abuse.
The priest, expelled from the Jesuit order in 2023 after it found the accusations against him to be "very highly" credible, is not known to have commented publicly on the allegations.
The head of the Vatican's powerful doctrinal office first announced a Church trial against Rupnik in October 2025. Such trials are held behind closed doors and there have been few updates since. In July, the Vatican [USN:L8N4510TH TEXT:"denied reports"] that a decision had been made in the case.

items.title: Juventus keeper Grabara undergoes knee surgery after ACL tear
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Juventus keeper Kamil Grabara has undergone knee surgery after tearing his anterior cruciate ligament during training, the 27-year-old announced on social media on Wednesday.
items.body:
Juventus keeper Kamil Grabara has undergone knee surgery after tearing his anterior cruciate ligament during training, the 27-year-old announced on social media on Wednesday.
Grabara is set to miss Poland's Nations League group stage matches against Bosnia and Herzegovina, with media reports saying the keeper faces up to seven months on the sidelines.
"I’m not going to lie, this is not something I ever wanted to post, but life comes at you fast sometimes," Grabara wrote on Instagram, posting a picture of himself on a hospital bed.
After joining Juventus on loan from Wolfsburg in August, Grabara debuted for the Serie A side on Thursday, providing an assist and winning the player-of-the-match award in a [USN:L6N45917E TEXT:"5-0 Europa League win"] over NEC Nijmegen.
On Saturday, however, he felt a strain in his right knee during training, and tests revealed he had suffered an ACL tear.
Local media reported that Juventus were nearing a deal with 37-year-old Brazilian Neto, who played for the club from 2015 to 2017, as Grabara's replacement.

items.title: Alonso pide cambios tras el "asesinato" de los circuitos de F1
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El piloto español Fernando Alonso pidió el miércoles a la Fórmula 1 que haga que las carreras sean más divertidas el año que viene, afirmando que muchos de los circuitos actuales han perdido su carácter tradicional.
items.body:
El piloto español Fernando Alonso pidió el miércoles a la Fórmula 1 que haga que las carreras sean más divertidas el año que viene, afirmando que muchos de los circuitos actuales han perdido su carácter tradicional.
El Gran Premio de Azerbaiyán comienza el viernes con la primera sesión de entrenamientos. La última carrera se celebró en Madrid por primera vez, pero el circuito fue objeto de críticas por parte de varios pilotos, entre ellos el campeón del mundo Lando Norris. Otros calificaron la carrera de "desfile".
Alonso no solo se mostró crítico con el circuito MadRing en unas declaraciones a Motorsport.com, sino que afirmó que varios circuitos no propiciaban carreras emocionantes.
"Silverstone, un circuito increíble, ya no es divertido", afirmó Alonso.
"En Spa fue casi vergonzoso pasar por Eau Rouge; en Suzuka, la 130R… Hay circuitos que han sido asesinados este año", afirmó.
El piloto de Aston Martin se mostró optimista respecto a la popularidad actual de la Fórmula 1, pero también se pronunció a favor de introducir más cambios en la potencia del motor.
La Fórmula 1 ha anunciado cambios para 2027 en lo que respecta al equilibrio de potencia entre el componente eléctrico y el de combustión.
Alonso reduciría la aceleración inmediata que proporciona el componente eléctrico a cambio de mantener la velocidad durante más tiempo. Es un tema, según afirma, que comenta habitualmente con el director ejecutivo de la Fórmula 1, Stefano Domenicali, y con Mohammed Ben Sulayem, presidente de la Federación Internacional del Automóvil.
"Quizá desde la cabina, al volante, sobre todo si estás en otras categorías o has probado otros monoplazas de Fórmula 1, se siente cierta frustración", afirmó Alonso.

items.title: Russian military helicopter entered Polish airspace briefly, Polish army says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter made a brief incursion into NATO member Poland's airspace from the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, the Polish Army Operational Command said on Wednesday.
items.body:
A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter made a brief incursion into NATO member Poland's airspace from the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, the Polish Army Operational Command said on Wednesday.
The helicopter spent 42 seconds in Polish airspace and entered to a maximum depth of about 300 metres (328 yards), it said on X.
"Fighter aircraft were scrambled, and ground-based forces and assets remained on standby. The nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defense," it said.
Poland is on heightened alert for any incursion into its airspace connected with Russia's war in Ukraine .
The Russian embassy in Warsaw did not immediately reply to a Reuters request for comment on the incident.

items.title: Los líderes de Tigré anuncian una nueva guerra contra el Gobierno etíope
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los líderes de la región de Tigré, en el norte de Etiopía, afirmaron el miércoles que habían entrado en una nueva guerra con el Gobierno federal, al estallar los combates en Tigré y en dos regiones vecinas, lo que ha roto un acuerdo de paz que llevaba cuatro años en vigor.
items.body:
Los líderes de la región de Tigré, en el norte de Etiopía, afirmaron el miércoles que habían entrado en una nueva guerra con el Gobierno federal, al estallar los combates en Tigré y en dos regiones vecinas, lo que ha roto un acuerdo de paz que llevaba cuatro años en vigor.
La guerra civil de 2020-2022 entre el Frente Popular de Liberación de Tigré (TPLF, por sus siglas en inglés) y las fuerzas federales se saldó con cientos de miles de muertos antes de que se firmara el Acuerdo de Pretoria en noviembre de 2022.
El estallido de nuevos combates se produce tras meses de creciente animosidad entre ambas partes, que culminó con el anuncio del domingo de que el TPLF había formado una alianza con otros seis grupos armados de toda Etiopía con el objetivo de derrocar al Gobierno del primer ministro Abiy Ahmed.
"Tras la intensificación de la invasión llevada a cabo mediante diversos métodos por el régimen autocrático y genocida de la Prosperidad de Abiy Ahmed contra el pueblo de Tigré (...), el Gobierno Regional Nacional de Tigré anunció que se ha ordenado a las Fuerzas de Tigré que contrarresten el ataque y que han entrado en una guerra defensiva", dijo el Gobierno regional liderado por el TPLF en un comunicado.
Getachew Reda, asesor de Abiy y antiguo dirigente del TPLF, escribió en la red social X que el TPLF había tomado el control de los aeropuertos de Tigré, gestionados por el Gobierno federal, y había lanzado una "ofensiva a gran escala" contra las posiciones gubernamentales en las regiones vecinas de Afar y Amhara.
Ethiopian Airlines suspendió los vuelos a la región.
GRUPOS ARMADOS SE ALIAN CON LOS TIGRANIOS Cuatro fuentes —entre ellas un alto cargo del Gobierno etíope, una fuente diplomática, una fuente humanitaria y otra fuente vinculada al TPLF y a una milicia aliada— confirmaron los acontecimientos en Tigré, Afar y Amhara.
Afirmaron que, en Afar, las fuerzas tigranias luchaban junto a un grupo armado local, y que, en Amhara, luchaban junto a la milicia Fano.
Fano se alineó con el Gobierno federal durante la guerra de 2020-2022, pero se rebeló contra él en 2023. Forma parte de la nueva alianza con el TPLF.
Los portavoces de Abiy, del Gobierno federal y del TPLF no respondieron de inmediato el miércoles a las solicitudes de comentarios. El Gobierno federal ha acusado al TPLF de violar el Acuerdo de Pretoria y de intentar sembrar el caos.
La portavoz de Abiy, Billene Seyoum, declaró el lunes a Reuters que los miembros de la recién anunciada alianza llevaban tiempo colaborando con el respaldo financiero de Eritrea, país vecino y adversario histórico de Etiopía.
Eritrea ha negado en repetidas ocasiones las acusaciones de que apoya a grupos armados etíopes. Su ministro de Información se negó a hacer comentarios el miércoles sobre los últimos acontecimientos.

items.title: Un trabajador muere en un accidente en el Coliseo, según el Ministerio de Cultura italiano
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Un trabajador falleció en un accidente ocurrido en el Coliseo de Roma el martes por la noche, informó el Ministerio de Cultura italiano, y parte de la zona permanecía cerrada durante todo el miércoles en señal de respeto.
items.body:
Un trabajador falleció en un accidente ocurrido en el Coliseo de Roma el martes por la noche, informó el Ministerio de Cultura italiano, y parte de la zona permanecía cerrada durante todo el miércoles en señal de respeto.
El técnico, de 22 años, falleció tras caer unos 10 metros mientras instalaba un nuevo sistema de iluminación en el interior del antiguo anfiteatro romano.
"Un suceso trágico que nos ha dejado conmocionados y atónitos", dijo el ministro de Cultura italiano, Alessandro Giuli, en un comunicado.
Construido hace 2.000 años, el Coliseo fue el anfiteatro más grande del Imperio romano y se utilizaba para celebrar combates de gladiadores, ejecuciones y cacerías de animales. Sigue siendo una de las principales atracciones turísticas de la ciudad.
El Parque Arqueológico del Coliseo anunció que cerraría la sección de la segunda grada, donde se produjo el accidente en señal de luto.
El mayor sindicato de Italia, la CGIL, se mostró en desacuerdo con la decisión y afirmó que todo el recinto debería permanecer cerrado durante el día.
"Esperamos que el ministro Giuli aclare lo sucedido y ordene el cierre total del Coliseo", dijo Natale di Cola, secretario general de la CGIL en Roma.
"La humanidad está por encima de los turistas", añadió.

items.title: LA28 unveils Venice Beach triathlon courses for 2028 Olympics
items.author: Rory Carroll
items.creator: Rory Carroll
items.summary: Los Angeles 2028 organizers unveiled preliminary triathlon courses for the Olympic and Paralympic Games on Wednesday, setting the events in Venice Beach with a shared finish line overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
items.body:
Los Angeles 2028 organizers unveiled preliminary triathlon courses for the Olympic and Paralympic Games on Wednesday, setting the events in Venice Beach with a shared finish line overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
The routes, which remain subject to operational testing, will use a central transition area near the beach, allowing spectators to watch athletes move between swimming, cycling and running segments.
Organizers said the generally flat cycling and running courses were designed to encourage fast racing.
The women's individual triathlon at the Games is scheduled for July 15 and will be the first event in which LA28 medals are awarded. The men's individual race will follow the next day with the mixed relay set for July 20.
In the individual events, competitors begin with a 1.5 km ocean swim, entering the water directly from the beach rather than from a pontoon. The swim will comprise a 1,000m lap, followed by a brief beach run and a second 500m lap.
Athletes will then complete eight 5 km cycling laps, including stretches on the Venice Beach path and city streets, before a four-lap, 10 km run that will cross bridges in the Venice Canals area.
The mixed relay will feature teams of four athletes competing in alternating women-men-women-men order. Each athlete will swim 350m, cycle 6.6 km and run 1.6 km before handing off to a teammate.
Paralympic individual races, scheduled for August 18-19, 2028, will include a 750 m swim starting from a barge beyond the breakwater, followed by a 20 km bike course and a 5 km run. Events will include athletes across six sport classes.
LA28 said the courses will be tested during a World Triathlon T50 Triathlon World Tour event in Venice from July 16-18, 2027.

WASHINGTON, Sept 23 : Verizon is investing $70 million in a nationwide effort to provide AI training to job seekers, small business and educators as the U.S. economy undergoes a dramatic transformation, it said on Wednesday.
The U.S. telecom company is partnering major non-profit programs such as Goodwill Industries and aims to offer AI training to hundreds of thousands of people using training resources from companies including IBM, Google, Anthropic, Microsoft and OpenAI.
"AI will change the face of the workforce," Verizon CEO Dan Schulman said in an interview. "You have to do this in order to protect the democracy."
Schulman wants large companies to join the effort to boost funding to help workers acquire skills for specific AI-related jobs. "It's in the self-interest of all business leaders to step up," Schulman said. "If every Fortune 100 (company) put $50 million or $70 million into this, we have a multibillion-dollar fund."
Verizon announced last year that it was investing $20 million to help departing employees gain AI skills after it announced it was cutting 13,000 jobs. The new effort adds $50 million.

items.title: McDonald's outlines $8.5 billion plan to support franchisees
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: McDonald's on Wednesday outlined about $8.5 billion in franchisee support as part of an expanded growth plan and set targets for margin and market share growth as it looks to revive momentum after several quarters of slower performance.
items.body:
McDonald's (MCD.N) on Wednesday outlined about $8.5 billion in franchisee support as part of an expanded growth plan and set targets for margin and market share growth as it looks to revive momentum after several quarters of slower performance.
Launched in June, McDonald's "NEXT" strategy focuses on improving food quality, hospitality, value and innovation to boost growth.
Persistent inflation and fierce competition over value offerings have pressured McDonald's and other fast-food chains, contributing to slower sales growth in the U.S. and international markets.
Last month, McDonald's [USN:L6N44017R TEXT:"missed "]estimates for second-quarter U.S. sales growth, citing execution missteps that hindered efforts to win back lower-income consumers who had cut back on dining out.
McDonald's also named industry veteran and company insider [USN:L6N441161 TEXT:"Skye Anderson"] as president of its U.S. business to help drive its turnaround strategy.
Ahead of its investor day, McDonald's said it would invest about $8.5 billion in its NEXT strategy through 2036, including roughly $5 billion by 2030, through rent relief and capital support for franchisees.
McDonald's said its estimated 250-basis-point efficiency gain would add about $100,000 in annual cash flow for the average U.S. restaurant, with franchisees expected to recoup the investment in about four years.
The burger chain targets unit expansion to contribute nearly 2.5% to systemwide sales growth in 2027 and about 2% by 2030, with operating margins expected in the low- to mid-50% range by 2030. The company's total adjusted operating margin for fiscal 2025 was 46.9%.

items.title: EU could recoup third of US economic lead with bigger firms, ECB says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The European Union could close a third of its productivity gap with the United States if it had as many large companies, the European Central Bank said on Wednesday, adding its voice to calls for reforms that make it easier for businesses to scale up.
items.body:
The European Union could close a third of its productivity gap with the United States if it had as many large companies, the European Central Bank said on Wednesday, adding its voice to calls for reforms that make it easier for businesses to scale up.
[USN:L6N45A0VH TEXT:"European policymakers"] are [USN:L6N40412Z TEXT:"trying to tackle"] the EU's economic underperformance relative to the United States, which is home to many of the world's largest companies and is leading the race to develop artificial intelligence.
EU workers produce 20% less output per hour than their US counterparts, according to academic studies . They were almost on an even keel in 1995.
ECB staff found that if Europe had the same distribution of large and small firms as the United States – without changing how productive each type of company is – the productivity gap would shrink by roughly one-third.
Large firms are significantly more productive than smaller ones. Companies with at least 250 employees generate an average of €86,800 in value added per worker annually, while firms with fewer than 10 employees produce less than half that amount.
The ECB said Europe's weaker productivity performance also reflects lower innovation, fragmented regulation and less developed capital markets, all of which make it harder for companies to grow and compete internationally.
The central bank backed the [USN:L8N4072DT TEXT:"proposed "EU Inc" framework"], an EU-wide corporate law regime aimed at reducing barriers to cross-border business activity.
Modelled loosely on Delaware's corporate framework in the United States, EU Inc would create a single legal structure operating across the bloc, bypassing a patchwork of 27 national company law systems and dozens of corporate forms.
"EU Inc. has the potential to support the Single Market, by strengthening competition, innovation and productivity growth," the ECB said.

items.title: Columbus Crew despide a técnico Federico Higuaín tras ser acusado de sexismo hacia una árbitra
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Columbus Crew, club de la Major League Soccer (MLS), destituyó el martes al entrenador del equipo filial, Federico Higuaín, tras una acusación de sexismo hacia una árbitra.
items.body:
El Columbus Crew, club de la Major League Soccer (MLS), destituyó el martes al entrenador del equipo filial, Federico Higuaín, tras una acusación de sexismo hacia una árbitra.
"No te olvides de que esto es un deporte de hombres", fue el comentario ofensivo que pronunció, según la Asociación Profesional de Árbitros de Fútbol (PSRA).
Federico, hermano del exinternacional argentino Gonzalo Higuaín, fue expulsado y sancionado con dos partidos de suspensión tras el altercado ocurrido en un partido el 23 de agosto.
"Hemos determinado que lo mejor para nuestro club, los jugadores y el cuerpo técnico es destituir a Federico Higuaín de sus funciones", declaró Issa Tall, director general del Columbus Crew, en un comunicado.
"Tras las conversaciones mantenidas esta semana y después de evaluar más a fondo lo ocurrido durante el último mes, se ha constatado que no se han cumplido los estándares de nuestro club en cuanto a lo que se espera de un líder de uno de nuestros equipos", agregó.
El incidente tuvo lugar durante un partido de la MLS NEXT Pro, la liga de formación afiliada a la MLS. Sin nombrarlo, la asociación de árbitros afirmó que un entrenador apretó la mano de una árbitra y se negó a soltarla después de que ella le pidiera que parara, antes de proferir el comentario sexista.
El Columbus Crew no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre Higuaín. El exdelantero, de 41 años, jugó en Argentina, Turquía y México antes de fichar por el Columbus Crew, donde disputó más de 200 partidos.
El sindicato de árbitros criticó la suspensión inicial de dos partidos por considerarla insuficiente y pidió una sanción más severa, alegando que las árbitras no deberían tener que soportar intimidaciones ni comentarios discriminatorios en su lugar de trabajo.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: General Mills a dépassé mercredi les prévisions de chiffre d'affaires pour le premier trimestre, citant une demande accrue de produits de base et de céréales pour le petit-déjeuner.
items.body:
General Mills (GIS.N) a dépassé mercredi les prévisions de chiffre d'affaires pour le premier trimestre, citant une demande accrue de produits de base et de céréales pour le petit-déjeuner.
Confrontés à une inflation élevée, les consommateurs sont nombreux à préférer manger chez eux, ce qui a stimulé les ventes de produits d'épicerie et d'aliments conditionnés.
La société a annoncé un chiffre d’affaires trimestriel de 4,39 milliards de dollars (3,85 milliards d'euros), contre une estimation moyenne des analystes de 4,35 milliards de dollars, selon les données compilées par LSEG.
Toutefois, la marge brute ajustée du fabricant de la marque Pillsbury a reculé de 90 points de base pour s'établir à 33,3% du chiffre d'affaires net, en raison de la hausse des coûts des intrants.
Elle a réalisé un bénéfice ajusté de 75 cents par action pour le trimestre, contre 86 cents par action l'année dernière.

items.title: Brève incursion d'un hélicoptère russe en Pologne, dit l'armée polonaise
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Un hélicoptère militaire russe de type Mi-8 a effectué une brève incursion dans l'espace aérien de la Pologne à partir de l'enclave russe de Kaliningrad, a déclaré mercredi l'armée polonaise.
items.body:
Un hélicoptère militaire russe de type Mi-8 a effectué une brève incursion dans l'espace aérien de la Pologne à partir de l'enclave russe de Kaliningrad, a déclaré mercredi l'armée polonaise.
L'hélicoptère a volé 42 secondes dans l'espace aérien de la Pologne, membre de l'Otan, a fait savoir l'armée sur X.
"Des avions de chasse ont été mobilisés, et les forces et moyens au sol sont restés en état d'alerte. La nature de cet incident indique que la Russie teste une nouvelle fois l'état de préparation de notre défense aérienne", a-t-elle déclaré.
La Pologne, frontalière de l'Ukraine au sud-est et de la Russie au nord, est en état d’alerte renforcé depuis le début du conflit entre la Russie et l'Ukraine en février 2022.
L’ambassade de Russie à Varsovie n’a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire concernant l'incident.

items.title: Aaron Nola, Phillies close in on postseason berth in matchup with Brewers
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Aaron Nola's turnaround is a big reason why the Philadelphia Phillies are on the verge of clinching a postseason berth.
items.body:
Aaron Nola's turnaround is a big reason why the Philadelphia Phillies are on the verge of clinching a postseason berth.
Nola will take the mound on Wednesday night when the Phillies continue their three-game home series with the playoff-bound Milwaukee Brewers.
In Tuesday's series opener, Philadelphia won 6-4 as Bryson Stott delivered the go-ahead RBI single in the eighth inning. Reliever Jhoan Duran ran into trouble in the ninth but earned his 33rd save.
Zack Wheeler struck out 11 over 5 2/3 innings while Brandon Marsh homered and drove in three runs for the Phillies (87-70), who lowered their magic number to clinch a wild-card spot to two.
"Huge team win for us. ... It took all of us tonight, and it started with Wheels," said Marsh, noting how Wheeler, 36, struck out the first seven batters he faced and also reached 2,000 strikeouts for his career. "It was a special night."
The Phillies will look for three straight wins for the first time since winning six games in a row from Aug. 26 to Sept. 1. They'll have a good chance if they can get another strong performance from Marsh, who had not homered in more than a month before Tuesday's blast.
"We've got a special group," Marsh said. "Tremendous amount of talent on this team. A bunch of dogs. We've just got to put it together at the right time -- and tonight was one of those times."
Nola (7-10, 4.49 ERA) had a 6.04 ERA at the end of June, but the veteran right-hander has worked his way back into form. He has a 1.33 ERA in September, including a scoreless seven-inning stint in Thursday's 3-0 triumph over the New York Mets.
"We're just seeing the pitcher that Aaron Nola always can be," catcher Garrett Stubbs said after that outing. "We're just getting the best out of who he is, and I think maybe we lost that for a second. ... Sometimes you need some help finding it again. But to me, it's vintage Aaron Nola."
Nola allowed three runs in 4 2/3 innings against the Brewers on June 13. For his career, he is 7-3 with a 3.22 ERA against them.
The Brewers (98-59), who have clinched the National League Central title, are only one game ahead of the Los Angeles Dodgers in the race for the best record in the majors. Milwaukee had won 10 of its previous 12 games before Tuesday's defeat, although the team still clinched a first-round playoff bye and home-field advantage in the NLDS when the Atlanta Braves lost Tuesday.
"The story of the game is that Wheeler was dominant," said Milwaukee manager Pat Murphy, whose team tied the score against Wheeler in the sixth before falling behind late. "He really did a great job. Terrific pitcher."
Right-hander Logan Henderson (10-3, 2.51 ERA) will take the mound for the Brewers on Wednesday in his first career appearance against Philadelphia.
In his most recent start, Henderson surrendered three runs in five innings in his team's 5-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates last Wednesday. He allowed a pair of home runs but struck out eight and walked only one in an 87-pitch effort.
"He was great," Murphy said. "He'd like to have a pitch back or two, but I think he was great. This is a great team in their yard, and now that they're healthy, I think they're a really good offense. I thought Logan did a great job keeping it under control."
-Field Level Media

items.body:
Os contratos futuros de minério de ferro registraram ligeira alta nesta quarta-feira, continuando a se estabilizar após a forte queda da semana passada, já que interrupções na oferta no Brasil associadas ao El Niño forneceram suporte de curto prazo, compensando a pressão baixista pela fraca rentabilidade das siderúrgicas chinesas.
O contrato de minério de ferro para janeiro mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian (DCE) na China subiu 0,07%, a 712 iuanes (US$106,18) por tonelada. Na semana passada, ele despencou quase 1%.
A referência de minério de ferro para outubro na Bolsa de Cingapura ficou praticamente estável, a US$96 por tonelada.
A demanda por minério de ferro costuma se fortalecer antes do feriado da Semana Dourada, em outubro, na China, principal mercado consumidor do insumo, afirmaram analistas da ANZ Research em uma nota.
Mais cedo, os preços haviam sido pressionados por uma perspectiva de oferta robusta, menor confiança nas perspectivas de demanda por aço na China e a aceleração do projeto Simandou, na Guiné, segundo analistas da BMI em um relatório.
No Brasil, importante produtor de minério de ferro, o El Niño tende a trazer chuvas mais intensas do que o habitual, o que pode atrapalhar o transporte ferroviário de minério e retardar as operações de carregamento nos portos, afirmou um analista baseado na Malásia.
A rentabilidade fraca das siderúrgicas na China continuou sendo um fator de pressão.
A taxa de operação dos altos-fornos entre 247 siderúrgicas na China caiu 0,8 ponto percentual em relação à semana anterior, para 82,32% em 22 de setembro, enquanto a utilização da capacidade aumentou 0,5 ponto percentual, para 89,23%, segundo dados da consultoria Mysteel.
(Reportagem de Emily Ou Yong)

items.title: Rússia reduz previsões de produção e exportação de gás natural
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Ministério da Economia da Rússia prevê que o país produza e exporte menos gás natural este ano do que o previsto anteriormente, de acordo com um rascunho de documento do governo ao qual a Reuters teve acesso, enquanto a Europa se prepara para encerrar suas últimas compras de gás russo.
items.body:
O Ministério da Economia da Rússia prevê que o país produza e exporte menos gás natural este ano do que o previsto anteriormente, de acordo com um rascunho de documento do governo ao qual a Reuters teve acesso, enquanto a Europa se prepara para encerrar suas últimas compras de gás russo.
No início deste mês, a Reuters informou que a Rússia também havia [USN:L8N44P12J TEXT:"reduzido sua previsão de produção de petróleo para 2026"] para o menor nível em 17 anos e revisado as perspectivas de exportação de combustível para este ano e o próximo devido à guerra com a Ucrânia.
As previsões serão utilizadas para atualizar o orçamento federal até 2029.
As projeções de produção e exportação de gás natural foram revisadas para baixo no contexto do rompimento das relações econômicas e políticas com o Ocidente devido à guerra na Ucrânia e aos planos da União Europeia de interromper todas as compras de gás russo a partir do próximo ano.
De acordo com o rascunho da previsão, a produção de gás natural na Rússia neste ano totalizará 683,1 bilhões de metros cúbicos, 5,3 bilhões de metros cúbicos abaixo do esperado na projeção de maio, mas ainda acima dos 662,7 bilhões de metros cúbicos produzidos em 2025.
O Kremlin afirmou este mês que a Europa [USN:L8N4510UQ TEXT:"estava prejudicando"] a si mesma ao comprar gás caro no mercado à vista, em vez de optar por suprimentos russos mais baratos. Moscou afirma estar pronta para retomar o fornecimento de gás à Europa, inclusive por meio dos gasodutos submarinos Nord Stream, cujo trecho permanece intacto após as explosões em setembro de 2022.
As exportações de gás natural liquefeito (GNL) marítimo da Rússia devem aumentar para 35 milhões de toneladas este ano, ante 30,3 milhões de toneladas em 2025, mas esse volume ainda é 5,3 milhões de toneladas menor do que o previsto anteriormente.
As exportações de GNL devem continuar a crescer nos próximos anos, mas em um ritmo mais lento do que o previsto anteriormente, segundo o documento.
As exportações de gás da Rússia para a Europa caíram 44% no ano passado, para apenas 18 bilhões de metros cúbicos, o menor nível desde meados da década de 1970, após o fechamento da rota de trânsito ucraniana, segundo cálculos da Reuters.
As exportações russas de gás por gasoduto para a Europa atingiram o pico de cerca de 180 bilhões de metros cúbicos por ano em 2018-2019.
(Reportagem da Reuters)

items.title: Diretores de empresas elevam perspectivas de inflação e veem juros com preocupação, diz pesquisa do Fed
items.author: Howard Schneider
items.creator: Howard Schneider
items.summary: Diretores financeiros de empresas esperam uma inflação mais alta neste ano e no próximo nos Estados Unidos e já começam a citar o aumento das taxas de juros como uma das principais preocupações, de acordo com uma nova pesquisa do Federal Reserve.
items.body:
Diretores financeiros de empresas esperam uma inflação mais alta neste ano e no próximo nos Estados Unidos e já começam a citar o aumento das taxas de juros como uma das principais preocupações, de acordo com uma nova pesquisa do Federal Reserve.
A pesquisa trimestral com cerca de 500 empresas mostrou que os diretores financeiros esperam aumentar os preços em média 5,3% este ano, acima do aumento de 4,6% observado no segundo trimestre e dos 3,6% registrados no início do ano. Os aumentos de preços no próximo ano foram estimados em média em 4,5% na pesquisa mais recente, contra 4,1% na pesquisa do segundo trimestre e 3,6% no início do ano.
O salto nas expectativas de preços ocorre mesmo com os diretores financeiros dando menos ênfase à inflação em sua lista de principais preocupações.
Em vez disso, a “política monetária” foi a questão mais citada, com cerca de 20% das empresas colocando-a no topo de sua lista de preocupações, em comparação com menos de 15% na última pesquisa — um corolário de seus próprios planos de preços, à medida que o Federal Reserve passou a elevar as taxas de juros na tentativa de reduzir a inflação, que, segundo eles, está se tornando mais generalizada e persistente.
A pesquisa foi realizada de 17 de agosto a 4 de setembro com uma amostra nacional de empresas de todos os portes. Isso ocorreu antes de o Fed elevar sua taxa básica de juros em 0,25 ponto percentual na semana passada, mas em um momento em que o debate sobre a política do Fed se voltava para prováveis aumentos nos juros e os investidores se preparavam para custos de financiamento mais elevados.
O otimismo geral em relação à economia entre os diretores financeiros permaneceu forte, mas as preocupações com o financiamento começaram a obscurecer as perspectivas entre as empresas menores, disse Sonya Waddell, vice-presidente e economista do Fed de Richmond, que realiza a pesquisa com diretores financeiros em conjunto com o Fed de Atlanta e a Fuqua School of Business da Universidade de Duke.
“Quando há desafios, eles são mais pronunciados para empresas pequenas e com restrições financeiras”, disse Waddell em um comunicado à imprensa que acompanha a pesquisa mais recente. Cerca de um quinto das pequenas empresas afirmou que as restrições de financiamento estão impedindo planos de expansão ou dificultando a cobertura de custos, e as empresas, de modo geral, preveem menos investimentos de capital nos próximos seis meses em comparação com as perspectivas de seis meses atrás.
Embora as autoridades do Fed afirmem não considerar as condições financeiras atuais restritivas, entre aqueles que não planejam investir, cerca de 42% citaram condições de financiamento desfavoráveis ou a necessidade de preservar o caixa como motivo, um aumento em relação aos 32% registrados há seis meses.
(Reportagem de Howard Schneider)

items.title: Coliseu da Itália fecha após morte de trabalhador em acidente
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O ministro da Cultura da Itália, Alessandro Giuli, determinou o fechamento do Coliseu por um dia, nesta quarta-feira, em sinal de respeito, após a morte de um trabalhador durante a madrugada em um acidente.
items.body:
O ministro da Cultura da Itália, Alessandro Giuli, determinou o fechamento do Coliseu por um dia, nesta quarta-feira, em sinal de respeito, após a morte de um trabalhador durante a madrugada em um acidente.
Andrea Moretti, um técnico de 22 anos, morreu após cair vários metros enquanto instalava um novo sistema de iluminação dentro da antiga arena romana.
Construído há 2.000 anos, o Coliseu era o maior anfiteatro do Império Romano, usado para sediar lutas de gladiadores, execuções e caçadas a animais. É a atração turística mais visitada da Itália.
“A notícia da trágica morte de Andrea Moretti, um trabalhador qualificado que faleceu durante a madrugada... nos chocou e entristeceu profundamente”, disse a primeira-ministra Giorgia Meloni.
O ministro da Cultura também ordenou a suspensão de todas as obras de construção e manutenção no Coliseu até segunda ordem.
Inicialmente, foi anunciado apenas um fechamento parcial do monumento, mas isso gerou protestos do maior sindicato da Itália, o CGIL.
“A humanidade vem antes dos turistas”, disse Natale di Cola, chefe da CGIL em Roma, acrescentando que o sindicato estava exigindo que Giuli explicasse todas as circunstâncias em torno do acidente de Moretti.
O incidente ocorre menos de um ano após a morte de um trabalhador romeno que ficou preso por horas sob os escombros de uma torre medieval parcialmente desabada perto do Coliseu, em novembro passado.

items.title: Lidl-owner among bidders for Tesco's Central European business, FT reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: German discount retailer Lidl's owner Schwarz Group is among the potential bidders for Tesco's TSCO.L Central European business as Britain's largest food retailer looks to retreat from overseas markets, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
items.body:
German discount retailer Lidl's owner Schwarz Group is among the potential bidders for Tesco's <TSCO.L> Central European business as Britain's largest food retailer looks to retreat from overseas markets, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
Here are some more details:
Dutch supermarket chain Ahold Delhaize (AD.AS) and Polish discount retailer Biedronka also intend to bid for Tesco's continental European business, which spans stores in Hungary, the Czech Republic and Slovakia, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.
Analysts view the grocery chain's 561 stores in Central Europe as an anomaly and contrary to its strategy to prioritise its home market.
Tesco leads in [USN:L8N44E0K4 TEXT:"market share"] for grocers in the UK, according to market researcher Worldpanel by Numerator, having invested heavily in the region.
However, soft consumer sentiment amid the conflict in the Middle East has pressured Tesco's sales in the UK, where it [USN:L8N42Q06U TEXT:"reported"] slower sales growth for the first quarter.
In July, media reports [USN:L4N43A0XQ TEXT:"emerged"] that Tesco was considering the sale of its Central European operations, having divested nearly all of its overseas assets since 2015 to focus on its core UK market.
Tesco is working with Goldman Sachs (GS.N) and Citi (C.N) as advisers for the sale, the FT report said.
Schwarz Group, Ahold Delhaize, Biedronka and Citi did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment. Goldman Sachs and Tesco declined to comment.

items.title: La IA está cambiando la forma en que los estadounidenses eligen los aperitivos, según Conagra
items.author: Alexander Marrow
items.creator: Alexander Marrow
items.summary: Los estadounidenses recurren cada vez más a la inteligencia artificial para saber qué picar entre horas, según Conagra Brands, un cambio que está contribuyendo a impulsar la demanda de alimentos con mayor contenido proteico, sabores intensos y productos adaptados a objetivos de salud específicos.
items.body:
Los estadounidenses recurren cada vez más a la inteligencia artificial para saber qué picar entre horas, según Conagra Brands, un cambio que está contribuyendo a impulsar la demanda de alimentos con mayor contenido proteico, sabores intensos y productos adaptados a objetivos de salud específicos.
Impulsados en parte por el rápido auge de los medicamentos para adelgazar y la iniciativa de la Casa Blanca "Make America Healthy Again" (Hagamos que Estados Unidos vuelva a estar sano), los consumidores buscan opciones alimentarias más saludables que nunca.
Conagra (CAG.N) , fabricante de las barritas de carne Slim Jim y el ketchup Hunt’s, colaboró con la empresa de investigación Circana para analizar más de 53 millones de transacciones de compra que abarcaban 17.000 productos del sector de los aperitivos en Estados Unidos.
Este sector genera 198.200 millones de dólares en ventas minoristas anuales y está creciendo aproximadamente 1,4 veces más rápido que el mercado alimentario en general.
En los seis años transcurridos desde la pandemia del COVID-19 han cambiado más cosas en la forma de comer y comprar alimentos de los estadounidenses que en los 50 años anteriores, afirmó Bob Nolan, vicepresidente sénior de ciencia del crecimiento de Conagra.
"Los aperitivos están desempeñando un papel cada vez más importante y personal en la vida de los consumidores, ya sea para obtener un aporte extra de proteínas, energía duradera o un momento de placer reconfortante", declaró Nolan el miércoles.
Las tendencias de salud son solo una parte de la historia. La investigación de Conagra reveló que los consumidores más jóvenes, en particular la Generación Z, están impulsando la demanda de sabores más atrevidos, desde combinaciones dulces y picantes hasta aperitivos ácidos y salados.
Los consumidores también están analizando más los ingredientes y recurren cada vez más a herramientas de IA para orientar sus decisiones de compra, según Conagra. En lugar de buscar un producto concreto, demandan snacks que satisfagan necesidades específicas, como un mayor contenido en proteínas o fibra.
"Por eso algunas categorías tradicionales se han visto sometidas a presión", dijo Nolan, señalando que las galletas y los aperitivos salados atraviesan dificultades. "La aparición de estos aperitivos más ricos en nutrientes y el consumo de aperitivos con un propósito específico ha empezado a crecer y a acelerarse de verdad", afirmó.

items.title: There’s a reason Trump is the only one talking about 1% rates
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: As a lifelong real estate investor whose businesses relied on debt and interest rates, U.S. President Donald Trump might be expected to know better: The one per cent rate he keeps demanding from the U ...
items.body: WASHINGTON -- As a lifelong real estate investor whose businesses relied on debt and interest rates, U.S. President Donald Trump might be expected to know better: The one per cent rate he keeps demanding from the U.S. Federal Reserve is impractical and would likely backfire, according to analysts. A policy rate slashed that low, from its current range of 3.75 per cent to four per cent, would likely touch off massive dislocation in the global financial system and end up with the U.S. government paying more to borrow than it does now in bond markets. Some figures close to the president say his interest rate demands should be seen less as a prescription and more as a way to deflect from issues like high consumer prices ahead of midterm elections in November. But in practical terms, a three-percentage-point cut by the Fed “seems cataclysmic,” said J. Benson Durham, founder of DASM investment research firm. Treasury rates would climb as investors priced higher inflation, countries like Germany could soak up capital by offering just a bit more to lenders than the US, and the dollar would “plummet,” he said. Yet despite the bond market math and concerns about Fed credibility, Trump has repeatedly called for ultra-low borrowing costs, which he says the U.S. deserves as the world’s largest economy with, he argues, the safest credit. Trump’s demands After the Fed under its relatively new chair, Kevin Warsh, hiked rates last week, Trump criticized the decision and repeated the one per cent figure. “The president in his own way is saying, ‘I don’t like the pain of this,’ but he should be clear that it’s not the fault of the Fed” for having to raise rates, said Grover Norquist, head of the conservative group Americans for Tax Reform, and an outside Trump economic adviser. Given the importance of controlling inflation ahead of the vote, some allies of the administration privately praised Warsh after the rate decision, according to one person involved in the exchanges, who requested anonymity to discuss them. A White House ally who liaises with Warsh told Reuters the calls for one per cent are unrealistic given the workings of global bond markets. “Can everybody just wake up? If you mess up the bond market, it’s good for the bond investor and no one else,” said the person. The White House did not respond to requests for comment. The Fed did not comment on Trump’s remarks. High inflation ahead of vote Trump’s pressure on the Fed goes beyond the one per cent rate request. He aims to oust Governor Lisa Cook, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, and is awaiting results of an inspector general’s probe of former Chair Jerome Powell’s oversight of a Fed construction project. Powell remains a Fed governor, denying Trump a new appointee at the central bank. Some analysts say the Fed remains a useful scapegoat for Trump, who heads into the midterms with mortgage rates nearing seven per cent and prices for staples like ground beef and gasoline also rising, underlining the issue of affordability. Inflation has increased since early in Trump’s term from the combined shocks of his tariffs and energy costs from the US war with Iran, among other things. The Fed’s preferred inflation measure was 3.7 per cent in July and the bank doesn’t expect that rate to fall to a two per cent target before 2029, suggesting inflation could remain elevated for Trump’s entire term. Tone shift The president’s public comments have mostly spared Warsh, his handpicked successor to Powell, and focused more on the Fed’s other policymakers. When Powell as chair ignored Trump’s various calls to cut rates or not raise them, the president called him an “enemy,” a “numb skull” and other epithets. By contrast last week, Trump characterized Warsh as being boxed in by a “political” board. After the Fed lifted rates for the first time in three years, in a unanimous vote, Trump said that he had told Warsh in a phone call beforehand to go along with the majority if necessary. Warsh has said he won’t discuss conversations with Trump. Long considered an inflation hawk, Warsh had weeks ago laid out the case for higher rates, surprising some analysts who had questioned his independence from Trump. Warsh “has repeatedly said the Fed will deliver price stability. Wednesday’s rate hike shows that he means it,” Apollo Global Chief Economist Torsten Slok said after the Fed’s Sept. 16 decision. Keeping an open line The relative leeway Trump is giving Warsh may reflect their warmer ties early in the new Fed chief’s term. Trump started chiding Powell early in his first presidency for raising rates, and the relationship remained tense. Powell did not openly push back against the rhetoric until early this year, when the administration sent a grand jury subpoena over the construction project. Warsh appears to have a more congenial relationship, fielding the president’s phone calls while maintaining he’ll remain an independent broker when it comes to monetary policy. That policy now includes a hardening stance against inflation. Polls show that pocketbook issues including record diesel fuel prices are hitting red state rural economies and small businesses, and that Trump’s record-low approval rating is dragging down Republican congressional candidates. A Reuters/IPSOS poll published Monday showed just 17 per cent of respondents approve of the president’s handling of the cost-of-living, the top issue Americans say will influence how they vote in six weeks. (Reporting by Howard Schneider; Editing by Dan Burns and Jonathan Spicer)

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: Angesichts der nahe der 100-Dollar-Marke verharrenden Ölpreise ziehen die Anleger an den europäischen Aktienmärkten die Köpfe ein. Der Dax gab am Mittwoch anfängliche leichte Gewinne wieder ab und notierte am Mittag 0,7 Prozent schwächer bei 25.409 Punkten. Auch der EuroStoxx50 gab leicht auf 6300 Zähler nach. "Die Energiepreise bleiben der entscheidende Risikofaktor", kommentierte Andreas Lipkow, Analyst beim Broker CMC Markets. Zwar sind die Ölpreise den sechsten Handelstag in Folge gesunken. items.body:
Angesichts der nahe der 100-Dollar-Marke verharrenden Ölpreise ziehen die Anleger an den europäischen Aktienmärkten die Köpfe ein. Der Dax (.GDAXI) gab am Mittwoch anfängliche leichte Gewinne wieder ab und notierte am Mittag 0,7 Prozent schwächer bei 25.409 Punkten. Auch der EuroStoxx50 (.STOXX50E) gab leicht auf 6300 Zähler nach. "Die Energiepreise bleiben der entscheidende Risikofaktor", kommentierte Andreas Lipkow, Analyst beim Broker CMC Markets. Zwar sind die Ölpreise den sechsten Handelstag in Folge gesunken. Der Preis für Brent-Rohöl aus der Nordsee verharrte dennoch weiterhin knapp unter 100 Dollar je Barrel.
"Es gelangt etwas mehr Rohöl auf den Markt, und die Wiederinbetriebnahme der Ost-West-Pipeline verschafft allen etwas Luft", sagte Matt Stanley vom Datenanbieter Kpler. Allerdings seien Diesel und Kerosin weiterhin knapp. "Und zunehmend werden die Endverbraucher die Folgen zu spüren bekommen." US-Präsident Donald Trump befürwortete am Vortag ein Exportverbot für Dieselkraftstoff. Der Preis für Diesel ist in den USA zuletzt auf ein Rekordhoch von 6,50 Dollar je Gallone gestiegen. Die hohen Treibstoffkosten werden zu einer immer größeren Belastung für Trump vor den anstehenden Zwischenwahlen.
Mit Aufmerksamkeit blickten Investoren zur Vollversammlung der Vereinten Nationen in New York und warteten auf diplomatische Fortschritte zur Beendigung des Krieges im Iran. Die Angebotssorgen milderte, dass Saudi-Arabien Insidern zufolge den Betrieb seiner Ost-West-Pipeline zum Roten Meer wieder aufgenommen hat. Auch der Irak will seine Ölexporte nach eigenen Angaben wieder steigern.
RÜSTUNGSWERTE LEGEN ZU Bei den Einzelwerten griffen Anleger zu Rüstungswerten. Rheinmetall (RHMG.DE) und Hensoldt (HAGG.DE) stiegen zeitweise um je zwei Prozent. Aktien des Rüstungstechnologiekonzerns Exosens (EXENS.PA) kletterten in Paris um vier Prozent, nachdem Bernstein das Kursziel hochgesetzt hatte. Die Aussicht auf einen Großauftrag der Bundeswehr trieb Secunet (YSNG.DE) -Aktien um 16 Prozent auf den höchsten Wert seit mehr als drei Jahren. Die Bundesregierung will die Kommunikationsnetze der Bundeswehr mit neuer Verschlüsselungstechnik für bis zu 1,7 Milliarden Euro modernisieren, wie aus einer Reuters vorliegenden Vorlage des Finanzministeriums für den Haushaltsausschuss des Bundestages hervorgeht. Der Ausschuss soll noch im Tagesverlauf grünes Licht für einen entsprechenden Rahmenvertrag mit Secunet geben.
Zu den größten Verlierern gehörten dagegen mit einem Minus von sieben Prozent die Titel von Arcadis (ARDS.AS) , nachdem das kanadische Ingenieurbüro WSP Global (WSP.TO) sein Übernahmeangebot für das niederländische Beratungs- und Ingenieurunternehmen zurückgezogen hatte. Nach enttäuschenden Zahlen brachen auch die Anteilsscheine von KWS Saat (KWSG.DE) um bis zu 11,5 Prozent ein. Der Saatguthersteller hat im abgelaufenen Geschäftsjahr die weltweit angespannte Lage der Landwirtschaft zu spüren bekommen und bei Umsatz und bereinigtem operativen Ergebnis Rückgänge verbucht.
POSITIVE DATEN - WARTEN AUF XI-TRUMP-TREFFEN Positive Impulse lieferten dagegen Wirtschaftsdaten. Der Einkaufsmanagerindex für die Privatwirtschaft legte im September überraschend um zwei volle Punkte auf 53,8 Zähler zu, wie der Finanzdienstleister S&P Global mitteilte. Dies ist der höchste Stand seit elf Monaten. Das Barometer stieg damit deutlich über die Marke von 50, ab der es Wachstum signalisiert. "Die Konjunktur erweist sich damit weiterhin als bemerkenswert widerstandsfähig gegenüber dem Energiepreisschock", sagte Deutsche-Bank-Volkswirtin Felicitas Henze.
Mit Spannung warteten Anleger zudem auf das Treffen von Trump mit dem chinesischen Präsidenten Xi Jinping. Bei seiner ersten Reise in die USA seit fast drei Jahren stehen die Spannungen zwischen den Supermächten in den Bereichen Handel und Technologie im Vordergrund. "Auf dem Tisch liegen Zölle, Exportbeschränkungen, Künstliche Intelligenz, Taiwan und der Irankrieg", konstatierte Jürgen Molnar, Stratege bei Robomarkets. Zwar sei von dem Treffen kein großer Durchbruch zu erwarten. "Aber schon eine Verlängerung des Burgfriedens wäre für die Börsen ein wichtiges Signal. Scheitert das Treffen, droht die nächste Eskalationsstufe im Handels- und Technologiekonflikt."
items.raw_description: Angesichts der nahe der 100-Dollar-Marke verharrenden Ölpreise ziehen die Anleger an den europäischen Aktienmärkten die Köpfe ein. Der Dax gab am Mittwoch anfängliche leichte Gewinne wieder ab und notierte am Mittag 0,7 Prozent schwächer bei 25.409 Punkten. Auch der EuroStoxx50 gab leicht auf 6300 Zähler nach. "Die Energiepreise bleiben der entscheidende Risikofaktor", kommentierte Andreas Lipkow, Analyst beim Broker CMC Markets. Zwar sind die Ölpreise den sechsten Handelstag in Folge gesunken. Der Preis für Brent-Rohöl aus der Nordsee verharrte dennoch weiterhin knapp unter 100 Dollar je Barrel.

［２３日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領が設置したパレスチナ自治区ガザの暫定統治機関「平和評議会」は、ガザ地区を対象とする６カ月間、２４億５０００万ドル規模の復興計画を２３日に開く加盟国会合で公表する。米ニュースサイトのアクシオスが報じた。

アクシオスによると、計画はインフラ整備、人材開発、経済活性化、デジタル化、法務、平和・治安の６分野、６６件の事業からなる。

計画は、ガザの物的被害を３５２億ドルと試算。完全な復興と再建には、今後１０年間で約７１４億ドルが必要になるとしている。

国境検問所の修復、電力・水道インフラの復旧、持ち運び可能な太陽光発電キット２万５０００基の配備、復興事業に必要な用地の地下にあるトンネルを恒久的に埋め戻す方針も示した。 

平和評議会とパレスチナ政府は２４億５０００万ドル全額をまだ確保していないが、政治的な障害が取り除かれれば、支援国が資金を拠出すると確信しているという。

items.title: Meta deve apresentar óculos inteligentes sem câmera em meio a crescentes preocupações com a privacidade
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Meta Platforms deve apresentar novos óculos inteligentes em sua conferência anual Connect, na quarta-feira, incluindo um modelo sem câmeras, em meio a crescentes preocupações com a privacidade em relação a dispositivos de IA que podem ser usados para gravar pessoas sem o consentimento delas.
items.body:
A Meta Platforms (META.O) deve apresentar novos óculos inteligentes em sua conferência anual Connect, na quarta-feira, incluindo um modelo sem câmeras, em meio a crescentes preocupações com a privacidade em relação a dispositivos de IA que podem ser usados para gravar pessoas sem o consentimento delas.
A gigante das redes sociais é a pioneira na corrida para colocar dispositivos de IA nas mãos dos clientes, com as vendas dos óculos inteligentes que desenvolveu em parceria com a EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) disparando no ano passado para mais de 7 milhões. Isso deu à Meta uma participação dominante em um mercado onde enfrenta principalmente a concorrência de empresas chinesas, como a RayNeo e a Xiaomi (1810.HK) .
Mas a crescente popularidade dos dispositivos gerou preocupação global quanto à sua capacidade de gravar pessoas secretamente, levando vários restaurantes, pubs e teatros do Reino Unido a restringir seu uso.
Os óculos também geraram ações judiciais, incluindo uma proposta de ação coletiva na Califórnia, na qual se alega que a Meta enganou os usuários sobre as proteções de privacidade e que os anotadores humanos responsáveis pelo treinamento de sua IA visualizaram e classificaram imagens de momentos privados das pessoas — incluindo trocas de roupa — após as gravações terem sido enviadas para seus servidores.
A Meta, que contesta as alegações e planeja se defender, deve lançar os óculos sem câmeras em dois modelos, um chamado Clubmaster e outro chamado Burbank, de acordo com o site The Information.
Analistas esperam que a empresa também lance uma nova versão de seus óculos Meta Ray-Ban, que vêm com câmeras, bem como um par de óculos de realidade aumentada mais finos e leves que, segundo reportagens, têm o codinome Phoenix.
O possível lançamento do Phoenix ocorre dias depois que a Snap revelou novas parcerias e detalhes de software sobre seus óculos de realidade aumentada Specs, que custam US$2.195 e serão lançados ainda este ano.
Alguns analistas, no entanto, duvidam que a simples remoção das câmeras seja suficiente para dissipar as preocupações com a privacidade em relação a dispositivos de IA que ainda podem gravar áudio. A perda da câmera também pode diminuir a demanda, já que a captura de fotos e vídeos está entre os recursos mais populares dos dispositivos.
“Microfones e captação de áudio poderiam suscitar preocupações semelhantes, embora provavelmente em menor grau”, disse Linda Sui, fundadora da Smart Analytics Global, uma empresa de pesquisa de mercado.
“Mais importante ainda, remover a câmera de óculos que também não possuem um visor frontal criará um desafio de diferenciação de produto. Os consumidores podem se perguntar por que precisam de óculos inteligentes em vez de fones de ouvido Bluetooth se a experiência principal se limita à interação por voz, microfones e alto-falantes.”
(Reportagem de Aditya Soni)

items.title: Alonso calls for changes after 'assassination' of F1 circuits
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Spanish driver Fernando Alonso on Wednesday called on Formula One to make races more fun next year, saying many of the current circuits had lost their traditional character.
items.body:
Spanish driver Fernando Alonso on Wednesday called on Formula One to make races more fun next year, saying many of the current circuits had lost their traditional character.
The Azerbaijan Grand Prix begins with first practice on Friday. The last race was held in Madrid for the first time, but the track faced criticism from several drivers, [USN:L6N4560FL TEXT:"including world champion Lando Norris"]. Others categorised the race as 'a procession'.
Alonso was critical not just of the MadRing circuit in statements made to Motorsport.com, but said that a number of tracks were not conducive to exciting races.
"Silverstone, an incredible track, is no longer fun," said Alonso.
"Spa was almost embarrassing going through Eau Rouge; Suzuka, the 130R... There are circuits that have been assassinated this year."
The Aston Martin driver was positive about the current popularity of Formula One, but also spoke in favour of more changes to the engine output.
Formula One has announced changes for 2027 regarding the balance of output between the electric component and the combustion component.
Alonso would reduce the immediate acceleration provided by the electric component in favour of maintaining speed for longer. It is a matter, he says, he regularly discusses with Formula One CEO Stefano Domenicali and Mohammed Ben Sulayem, the president of the International Automobile Federation.
"Maybe from the cockpit, behind the wheel, especially if you drive other categories or have experienced other Formula 1 cars, there's a bit of frustration," Alonso said.
"I don't have all the information. We have to trust in the sport."

items.title: Papierbelege sollen wegfallen - Handel trotzdem unzufrieden
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die Bundesregierung will die Bonpflicht abschaffen und mehr elektronische Kassen vorschreiben. Das Kabinett billigte dazu am Mittwoch einen Gesetzentwurf des Finanzministeriums. Papierbelege sollen ab 2028 durch digitale Alternativen ersetzt werden. "Das bedeutet für alle weniger Bürokratie - sowohl für Bürgerinnen und Bürger als auch für Unternehmen", sagte Finanzminister und SPD-Chef Lars Klingbeil am Mittwoch in Berlin. Der Einzelhandel kritisierte, dass die Regierung vom schwarz-roten Koalitionsvertrag abweichen will und die Bonpflicht nicht ersatzlos streicht. Die Wirtschaft fürchtet nun hohe Kosten bei der Umrüstung.
items.body:
Die Bundesregierung will die Bonpflicht abschaffen und mehr elektronische Kassen vorschreiben. Das Kabinett billigte dazu am Mittwoch einen Gesetzentwurf des Finanzministeriums. Papierbelege sollen ab 2028 durch digitale Alternativen ersetzt werden. "Das bedeutet für alle weniger Bürokratie - sowohl für Bürgerinnen und Bürger als auch für Unternehmen", sagte Finanzminister und SPD-Chef Lars Klingbeil am Mittwoch in Berlin. Der Einzelhandel kritisierte, dass die Regierung vom schwarz-roten Koalitionsvertrag abweichen will und die Bonpflicht nicht ersatzlos streicht. Die Wirtschaft fürchtet nun hohe Kosten bei der Umrüstung.
Moderne Kassensysteme sind im Handel bereits weit verbreitet. Es gibt jedoch noch etwa 115.000 sogenannte offene Ladenkassen. Deren Umsätze sind laut Finanzministerium missbrauchsanfällig, weil es keine oder nur handschriftliche Aufzeichnungen gibt. Mit digitalen Kassen würden alle Umsätze erfasst, so Klingbeil. "Damit verhindern wir Steuerhinterziehung und schaffen faire Wettbewerbsbedingungen. Ich will, dass die Ehrlichen nicht die Dummen sind." Die Maßnahme sei Teil des [USN:L8N43I18N TEXT:"Aktionsplans"] zur Bekämpfung von Steuer- und Finanzkriminalität.
Der Gesetzentwurf sieht vor, dass offene Ladenkassen für Unternehmen mit einem Jahresumsatz von mehr als 100.000 Euro ab 2028 durch elektronische Systeme ersetzt werden müssen. Ausgenommen davon sind Steuerpflichtige, die im Jahr Barumsätze im Wert von unter 12.000 Euro haben. Weitere Ausnahmen sollen nach der Verabschiedung des Gesetzes durch eine Verordnung geregelt werden. Denkbar sei dies beispielsweise in der Landwirtschaft, so das Finanzministerium.
EINZELHANDEL: "DAS IST ZU WENIG" Die Bonpflicht war 2020 von der damaligen Bundesregierung eingeführt worden, um Steuerbetrug zu erschweren. Besonders kleine Einzelhändler wie Bäckereien oder Kioske hatten sich über unnötige Bürokratie und zusätzlichen Müll beschwert. Der Hauptgeschäftsführer des Handelsverbandes HDE, Stefan Genth, sagte, im Koalitionsvertrag sei die Abschaffung der Bonpflicht vereinbart worden. Dies sei auch die Erwartung der Wirtschaft. "Nun aber, wie heute im Kabinett beschlossen, lediglich den Papierbon abzuschaffen und diesen durch einen verpflichtenden digitalen Beleg zu ersetzen, das ist zu wenig." Genth sprach von einer großen Enttäuschung. Es drohten für viele Betriebe erhebliche Investitionen in einer wirtschaftlich angespannten Situation.
Bei größeren Einkäufen sei das Datenvolumen des Belegs zu groß, erklärte Genth. "Er passt nicht auf den QR-Code. Deshalb muss der digitale Beleg auf einen Server übertragen werden und der Kunde erhält über den QR-Code einen Link zu diesem Server, wenn der Einzelhändler keine Kundenapp hat." Solche Systeme gebe es zum Teil schon. "Sie sind aber teuer und müssten erheblich ausgebaut werden." Laut Finanzministerium wird es für Konsumenten keine Pflicht geben, elektronische Belege anzunehmen.
Der Digitalverband Bitkom betonte, für Verbraucher bedeute das Gesetz weniger Papier. "Belege lassen sich leichter speichern und wiederfinden." Es müsse aber unmissverständlich geregelt werden, für wen genau die Kassenpflicht gelte und welche technischen Anforderungen zu erfüllen seien. Statt eines Flickenteppichs brauche es einheitliche technische Vorgaben, damit die Systeme nahtlos zusammenarbeiteten. In einer Bitkom-Umfrage hatten sich zuletzt 84 Prozent der Befragten dafür ausgesprochen, dass alle Geschäfte gesetzlich dazu verpflichtet werden sollten, neben Bargeld mindestens eine elektronische Bezahlmöglichkeit anzubieten.
Der Gesetzentwurf führt auch einen zusätzlichen Straftatbestand für den Einsatz und Vertrieb von Manipulationssoftware ein. Verstöße gegen die Kassenpflicht oder fehlende Belegbereitstellung sollen als Ordnungswidrigkeiten geahndet werden.

items.title: Bandas exteriores de lluvia del huracán Polo llegan a la costa de México
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las bandas de lluvia del huracán Polo llegaron el miércoles a la costa del Pacífico de México, lo que supone alto riesgo de inundaciones que ponen en peligro la vida de la población, informó el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos.
items.body:
Las bandas de lluvia del huracán Polo llegaron el miércoles a la costa del Pacífico de México, lo que supone alto riesgo de inundaciones que ponen en peligro la vida de la población, informó el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos.
Se prevé que Polo se mantenga en alta mar, pero su núcleo permanecerá cerca de la costa del suroeste de México durante los próximos uno o dos días, lo que provocará fuertes lluvias.
Los estados de Guerrero y Michoacán podrían registrar entre 8 y 20 centímetros de lluvia hasta el jueves, añadió el CNH en una nota de aviso.
Las intensas lluvias pueden provocar inundaciones y deslizamientos de tierra en esos estados, y afectar también las costas cercanas de Oaxaca, Colima y Jalisco.
Con vientos máximos sostenidos cercanos a los 250 kilómetros por hora y ráfagas más intensas, Polo es un huracán de categoría 4, tras haber alcanzado anteriormente la categoría 5.
"Se esperan fluctuaciones en la intensidad, pero se prevé que Polo continúe siendo un huracán muy poderoso durante los próximos días", dijo el CNH.
El Gobierno de México afirmó que estaba coordinando esfuerzos para reforzar las medidas de preparación y prevención a lo largo de la costa del Pacífico.
Los puestos de mando están operativos en los estados de Michoacán, Colima, Jalisco y Guerrero, según informó el Ministerio de Seguridad en un comunicado.
"Como parte de esta coordinación, se mantienen activos los puestos de Comando en Michoacán, Colima, Jalisco y Guerrero, a travé.s de los cuales se coordinan recorridos de identificación de riesgos, evaluación de condiciones, preparación de refugios temporales y, cuando las condiciones lo requieren, evacuaciones preventivas", dijo la nota.
